meaning.en: now, then, we shall explain the Great Upanishad
meaning.hi: अब हम महोपनिषद् की व्याख्या करेंगे

meaning.en: Narayana alone existed
neither Brahma nor Shiva
being alone, he did not delight
meaning.hi: अकेले होने से वे रमे नहीं

meaning.en: of him who was absorbed in meditation
fourteen beings are born, and one maiden
meaning.hi: चौदह पुरुष और एक कन्या जन्मते हैं

meaning.en: that One is the twenty-fifth, the Person
from the forehead a three-eyed being holding a trident
therefore he is the Lord, the Great God

words.sanskrit: lalatat svedah apatat, ta imah pratata apah

meaning.en: sweat fell from the forehead; these are the wide waters
meaning.hi: ललाट से पसीना गिरा; यही फैले हुए जल हैं

meaning.en: a golden disc of radiance
four-faced Brahma was born
facing east, the call Bhuh
meaning.hi: पूर्व की ओर मुख करके 'भूः' व्याहृति

meaning.en: the god with a thousand heads and a thousand eyes
meaning.hi: हज़ार सिरों और हज़ार आँखों वाले देव

meaning.en: the heart, like a lotus bud, facing downward
meaning.hi: कमल-कोश जैसा, नीचे की ओर मुख किया हृदय

meaning.en: a fine upward flame of fire
in the middle of that flame the Supreme Self is seated
meaning.hi: उस शिखा के मध्य परमात्मा स्थित हैं

words.sanskrit: sa brahma sa ishanah sendrah so'ksharah paramah svarat

meaning.en: he is Brahma, Shiva, Indra, the imperishable, the highest, self-ruling
meaning.hi: वही ब्रह्मा, ईशान, इन्द्र, अक्षर, परम, स्वराट् हैं

meaning.en: whoever studies this Great Upanishad daily
meaning.hi: जो इस महोपनिषद् को नित्य पढ़ता है

meaning.en: one unlearned in the Veda becomes learned
the uninitiated becomes initiated
purified by fire, by wind, by soma
meaning.hi: अग्नि, वायु और सोम से पवित्र

meaning.en: purified by truth, purified by all
has bathed at all holy places
meaning.hi: सब तीर्थों में स्नान किया हुआ

meaning.en: has performed all sacrifices
sixty thousand (repetitions) of the Gayatri
a hundred thousand of the epics and Puranas
ten thousand repetitions of Om
purifies the row (of diners) as far as the eye reaches
meaning.hi: जहाँ तक दृष्टि जाए, पंक्ति को पवित्र करता है

meaning.en: purifies seven generations
meaning.hi: सात पीढ़ियों को पवित्र करता है

meaning.en: so said the blessed Hiranyagarbha
by recitation one reaches immortality
meaning.hi: जप से अमृतत्व को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: one named Shuka
of great brilliance
devoted to the bliss of his own nature
meaning.hi: अपने स्वरूप के आनन्द में लीन

meaning.en: as soon as he was born
king among sages
attained that which is true
meaning.hi: जो सत्य है उसे पा लिया

meaning.en: by that, his own discernment
by himself alone
the great-minded one
reflecting long and well
meaning.hi: लम्बे समय तक भली-भाँति विचार करके

meaning.en: gained firm conviction of his own Self
because it is nameless
because it is unreachable
because it stands beyond the senses with mind as the sixth
meaning.hi: मन सहित छह इन्द्रियों से परे स्थित होने से

meaning.en: pure awareness alone
the Self is an infinitely fine point
subtler even than space
within the supreme point of awareness
meaning.hi: चेतना के परम अणु के भीतर

meaning.en: millions of universes like dust grains
coming into being and staying for a while
meaning.hi: उत्पत्ति और स्थिति को प्राप्त होकर

meaning.en: dissolve
through the shifting of its power
it is space, being empty of any outside
meaning.hi: बाहर से शून्य होने से वह आकाश है

meaning.en: yet not space, being awareness
meaning.hi: पर चेतना होने से आकाश नहीं

meaning.en: it is nothing, since it cannot be pointed out
meaning.hi: वह कुछ नहीं, क्योंकि उसका निर्देश नहीं हो सकता

meaning.en: yet it is something, as the reality of being
meaning.hi: पर सत्ता रूप वस्तु होने से वह कुछ है

meaning.en: it is conscious, being self-luminous
meaning.hi: प्रकाशरूप होने से वह चेतन है

meaning.en: like a stone, with nothing to be known
meaning.hi: जानने योग्य के अभाव में पत्थर जैसा

meaning.en: in its own Self, a sky at rest
meaning.hi: अपने में स्थित आत्मारूपी आकाश में

meaning.en: painter of the world-picture by opening its eyes
meaning.hi: आँखें खोलकर जगत का चित्र रचने वाला

meaning.en: this universe is only its shining
meaning.hi: यह विश्व उसी की आभा मात्र है

meaning.en: it cannot be separate from it
even the world's variety is its shining
meaning.hi: जगत का भेद भी उसी का प्रकाश है

meaning.en: difference too is made of it
meaning.hi: भेद भी उसी से बना है

meaning.en: all-pervading, connected with all
having nowhere to go, it does not move
meaning.hi: गति के अभाव में वह नहीं जाता

meaning.en: it is not, having no support
meaning.hi: आधार न होने से वह नहीं है

meaning.en: yet it is, being existence itself
meaning.hi: सत्स्वरूप होने से वह है भी

meaning.en: Brahman is understanding and bliss
the final goal of the one who gives
the laying down of all intentions
what is taken hold of by the mind
absence of the waking person's perceptions
the wise call its mark of recognition
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी जिसे उसका प्रत्यय कहते हैं

meaning.en: through its contracting and expanding
dissolutions and creations of the world
the resting point of the Upanishadic sayings
beyond the reach of words
I am indeed Brahman, being-awareness-supreme bliss
and nothing other
by his own subtle understanding
Shuka knew everything
though the supreme reality was reached by himself
meaning.hi: स्वयं परम वस्तु को प्राप्त कर लेने पर भी

meaning.en: he remained with an unrested mind
trust that 'this is the reality'
he did not attain within himself
only his mind ceased
restlessness toward sense objects
from pleasures that break again and again
like the chataka bird from streams of water
once, he of spotless understanding
meaning.hi: एक बार वे निर्मल बुद्धि वाले

meaning.en: sitting in solitude on Meru
asked his father with devotion
the sage Krishna Dvaipayana
this showy display of worldly existence
how did it arise, O sage
and how does it come to rest
meaning.hi: और यह कैसे शान्त होता है

meaning.en: tell me what it is, which, whose and when
meaning.hi: बताइए क्या, कौन-सा, किसका और कब

meaning.en: by the sage Vyasa, thus asked
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार पूछे गए मुनि व्यास द्वारा

meaning.en: everything to his son
the whole was told exactly as it is
what ought to be said, by the knower of the Self
I knew this before
meaning.hi: यह मैं पहले ही जान चुका था

meaning.en: that Shuka, by his own understanding
meaning.hi: वे शुक अपनी ही बुद्धि से

meaning.en: did not think much of the words
meaning.hi: वचनों को अधिक महत्त्व नहीं देते

meaning.en: the revered Vyasa, understanding
such an attitude in his son
replied again to his son
I do not know it in truth
meaning.hi: मैं इसे तत्त्व से नहीं जानता

meaning.en: a king named Janaka
lives in the city of Mithila
he knows what is to be known as it is
meaning.hi: वे जानने योग्य को यथार्थ रूप से जानते हैं

meaning.en: from him you will gain everything
Shuka, thus told by his father
meaning.hi: पिता द्वारा ऐसा कहे जाने पर शुक

meaning.en: went from Sumeru to the surface of the earth
reached the city of Videha
protected by Janaka
he was announced by the staff-bearers
to the great-souled Janaka
O king, Vyasa's son at the gate
meaning.hi: राजन्, द्वार पर व्यास के पुत्र

meaning.en: Shuka is standing here
to test and know Shuka
'let him stay', with seeming disregard
having said this, Janaka fell silent
meaning.hi: यह कहकर जनक चुप हो गए

meaning.en: for seven days
then he had him brought in
Shuka into the courtyard
there for seven days
he stayed just the same, with mind beyond it
meaning.hi: वैसे ही, मन से परे होकर रहे

meaning.en: then Janaka had him brought in
meaning.hi: फिर जनक ने उन्हें भीतर बुलवाया

meaning.en: into the courtyard of the inner palace
meanwhile the king was not seen
meaning.hi: तब तक राजा दिखाई नहीं दिए

meaning.en: thus for seven days, him
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार सात दिन तक उन्हें

meaning.en: there with passionate lovely women
with meals and heaps of pleasures
meaning.hi: भोजनों और भोगों के ढेर से

meaning.en: Janaka pampered
moon-faced Shuka
those pleasures, those foods
the mind of Vyasa's son
did not carry away
as a gentle breeze a firmly-based mountain
meaning.hi: जैसे मन्द पवन दृढ़ आधार वाले पर्वत को

meaning.en: simply even and clear
silent, with a glad mind
like the full cool-rayed moon
stainless Shuka remained
him whose nature was fully known
meaning.hi: जिनका स्वभाव भली-भाँति जान लिया गया

meaning.en: that Shuka, King Janaka
meaning.hi: उन शुक को राजा जनक ने

meaning.en: bringing in the joyful-souled one
seeing him, bowed
one whose worldly tasks are all finished
meaning.hi: जिसके जगत के कार्य समाप्त हो चुके

meaning.en: one who has attained every wish
what do you desire
having welcomed him, said to him
this pomp of worldly existence
how did it arise, O teacher
how does it come to rest
tell me quickly, exactly as it is
the whole was told exactly
by the great-souled Janaka
that very thing told before
meaning.hi: वही जो पहले कहा गया था

meaning.en: by his father of great wisdom
by myself, earlier
understood in detail
this very thing, when asked
was declared by my father
by you too this same meaning
has been told, O best of those who know speech
meaning.hi: कहा गया, हे वाणी-विशारदों में श्रेष्ठ

meaning.en: this is indeed the meaning of the sayings
seen throughout the scriptures
born of the mind's imaginings
through the full wearing away of those imaginings
meaning.hi: उन विकल्पों के पूर्ण क्षय से

meaning.en: it wanes
worldly life, burnt, is without substance
this is certain
so is this, O fortunate one
tell me the truth, unwavering
from you I shall find rest
with a mind wandering the world
listen now, then, you
this, being told by me
meaning.hi: मेरे द्वारा कहा जा रहा यह

meaning.en: the unfolding of knowledge
the innermost core of understanding's essence
by knowing which
a person at once
would attain liberation while living
by the understanding that the seen is not
wiping the seen from the mind
if it is accomplished
then the supreme bliss of nirvana is born
meaning.hi: तब परम निर्वाण-सुख उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: complete abandonment
of latent desires, which is the highest
is called liberation by the wise
meaning.hi: सज्जनों द्वारा मोक्ष कहा जाता है

meaning.en: that alone is the stainless path
those whose latent tendencies are pure
not again sharers in the misfortune of birth
meaning.hi: फिर जन्म रूपी अनर्थ के भागी नहीं

meaning.en: those who have known the knowable
great-minded ones liberated while living
firmness of belief in objects
is called bondage
thinning of latent desires, O knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: हे ब्रह्मन्, वासनाओं का क्षीण होना

meaning.en: is called liberation
by austerity and the like
yet without any such cause
meaning.hi: पर ऐसे किसी कारण के बिना

meaning.en: pleasures here do not appeal
that one is called liberated while living
as they arrive in their time
untouched amid pleasures and pains
neither rejoices nor droops
meaning.hi: न हर्षित होता है न खिन्न

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
elation, irritation, fear, anger
by the views of craving and meanness
meaning.hi: काम और कृपणता की दृष्टियों से

meaning.en: who is not touched within
meaning.hi: जो भीतर से छुआ नहीं जाता

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
having dropped the tendency made of ego
who, as if in play
remains, having given up the object of meditation
meaning.hi: ध्येय को भी त्यागकर स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
wanted and unwanted do not exist
for whom in the inner ways of seeing
who moves about like one in deep sleep
meaning.hi: जो सुषुप्ति की तरह विचरता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
delighting in the inner Self, seated at ease
full, of purifying mind
having reached unsurpassed rest
wants nothing here
who lives with clinging gone
by what is experienced, in the heart-space
meaning.hi: अनुभव किए जाने वाले से, हृदयाकाश में

meaning.en: is not smeared even slightly
whose awareness is not dull
that one is called liberated while living
liking and disliking, pleasure and pain
right and wrong, result and no result
who acts without dependence
meaning.hi: जो बिना अपेक्षा के करता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
given to silence, without the I-sense
without pride, free of jealousy
who acts with agitation gone
meaning.hi: जो उद्वेग-रहित होकर कर्म करता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
without clinging anywhere
who stands like a witness
meaning.hi: जो साक्षी की तरह स्थित है

meaning.en: engages in work without craving
meaning.hi: इच्छारहित होकर कार्य में लगा है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
by whom merit and demerit
the mind's thinking and striving
everything has been given up within
that one is called liberated while living
however much the construction of the seen
meaning.hi: जितनी भी दृश्य की कल्पना है

meaning.en: all of this that is beheld
meaning.hi: यह सब जो देखा जाता है

meaning.en: by whom it is thoroughly abandoned
that one is called liberated while living
pungent, sour, salty, bitter
tasteless and tasty too
who eats them all alike
meaning.hi: जो सबको समान भाव से खाता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
old age, death and calamity
kingship and poverty as well
who experiences them as delightful
meaning.hi: जो इन्हें रमणीय मानकर भोगता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
right and wrong, pleasure and pain
and likewise death and birth
by whose understanding these are well abandoned
meaning.hi: जिसकी बुद्धि ने इन्हें भली-भाँति त्याग दिया

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
free of agitation and excitement
with an even, clear understanding
neither grieves nor swells up
meaning.hi: न शोक करता है न उछलता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
all wishes, all doubts
all strivings, all fixed resolves
by whose understanding they are given up
meaning.hi: जिसकी बुद्धि ने इन्हें त्याग दिया

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
in birth, continuance and destruction
and in rising and setting
whose mind is just the same
meaning.hi: जिसका मन सम ही रहता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
hates nothing
and longs for nothing at all
who enjoys what comes naturally
meaning.hi: जो स्वाभाविक रूप से प्राप्त भोगों को भोगता है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
in whom the construction of worldly life is stilled
having parts, yet partless
who, though with a mind, is mind-free
meaning.hi: जो चित्त वाला होकर भी चित्तरहित है

meaning.en: that one is called liberated while living
in the whole web of affairs
though engaged in dealings, without longing
as if in another's affairs
complete in himself
leaving the state of liberation while living
when one's body is given over to time
meaning.hi: अपना शरीर काल के अधीन होने पर

meaning.en: enters bodiless liberation
as wind enters stillness
the one freed without body does not rise
does not set, does not become calm
meaning.hi: न अस्त होता है न शान्त होता है

words.sanskrit: na san na asan na durasthah

meaning.en: neither being, nor non-being, nor far off
meaning.hi: न सत्, न असत्, न दूर स्थित

words.sanskrit: na cha aham na cha na itarah

meaning.en: neither I nor other than I
then, still and deep
neither light nor darkness spread out
nameless and unmanifest
something real remains

words.sanskrit: na shunyam na api cha akarah

meaning.en: not a void, and not a form
not the seen, nor the seeing
the flood of elements and objects
not standing as their endless sum
meaning.hi: उनकी अनन्तता के रूप में स्थित नहीं

meaning.en: something whose nature cannot be named
meaning.hi: कुछ ऐसा जिसका स्वरूप अनिर्देश्य है

meaning.en: of a form fuller than the full
meaning.hi: पूर्ण से भी पूर्णतर रूप वाला

words.sanskrit: na san na asan na sad-asat

meaning.en: not being, not non-being, not both
meaning.hi: न सत्, न असत्, न सदसत्

meaning.en: neither a thing nor an imagining
pure awareness without object
endless, ageless, auspicious
without beginning, middle or end
meaning.hi: आदि, मध्य और अन्त से रहित

meaning.en: which is beginningless and free of ill
of the seer, the seeing and the seen
what is called seeing, in the middle
meaning.hi: मध्य में जो दर्शन कहा गया

meaning.en: nothing is higher than this
there is no other conclusion, O sage
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, दूसरा कोई निश्चय नहीं

meaning.en: known by you yourself
and heard again from the teacher
meaning.hi: और गुरु से फिर सुना गया

meaning.en: bound through the power of one's own intentions
meaning.hi: अपने संकल्पों के वश से बँधा

meaning.en: is freed through freedom from intention
meaning.hi: संकल्परहित होने से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: therefore by you yourself is known
what is to be known by a great soul
meaning.hi: जो महात्मा के जानने योग्य है

meaning.en: for aversion to pleasures has arisen
meaning.hi: क्योंकि भोगों से अरुचि उत्पन्न हुई

meaning.en: or to all that is seen here
meaning.hi: या यहाँ के सारे दृश्य से

meaning.en: all that was to be gained is gained
meaning.hi: प्राप्त करने योग्य सब प्राप्त हो गया

meaning.en: by you, with a full mind
in your own nature, the true discipline, O knower of Brahman
meaning.hi: हे ब्रह्मन्, स्वरूप रूपी तप में

meaning.en: you are free; give up the confusion
the far outer and the outer
the inner and innermost of the intellect
meaning.hi: बुद्धि का भीतरी और भीतर का भी भीतरी

meaning.en: Shuka, seeing, you would not see
meaning.hi: शुक, तुम देखते हुए भी नहीं देखोगे

meaning.en: the witness, complete and alone
Shuka rested in silence
meaning.hi: शुक मौन होकर विश्राम में आ गए

meaning.en: in the supreme reality, at ease
free of grief, fear and weariness
meaning.hi: शोक, भय और थकान से रहित

meaning.en: without striving, doubts cut away
went to the peak of Meru
for the sake of meditative absorption
unbroken
there for thousands of years
by absorption free of mental division
remaining in that place, he became still
meaning.hi: उस स्थान पर रहकर वे शान्त हो गए

meaning.en: in the Self, like a lamp without oil
meaning.hi: आत्मा में, बिना तेल के दीपक की तरह

meaning.en: pure, the stain of mental construction gone
meaning.hi: कल्पना के कलंक के हटने से शुद्ध

meaning.en: by himself in the stainless Self, the holy state
meaning.hi: स्वयं निर्मल आत्मा के पावन पद में

meaning.en: like a drop of water in the ocean
meaning.hi: समुद्र में जल की बूँद की तरह

meaning.en: with tendencies melted, went to oneness
meaning.hi: वासनाएँ गलकर एकता को प्राप्त हुए

meaning.en: a king of sages named Nidagha
a boy who had gained knowledge
went forth for pilgrimage
permitted by his father, by himself
at three and a half crore holy places
having bathed, came home
told his own story
the renowned one, bowing to Ribhu
meaning.hi: यशस्वी ने ऋभु को प्रणाम करके

meaning.en: at thirty-five million holy places
through the power of the merit of bathing
meaning.hi: स्नान के पुण्य के प्रभाव से

meaning.en: has arisen in my mind
this reflection, which is of this kind
meaning.hi: यह विचार, जो इस प्रकार का है

meaning.en: the world is born and dies
and dies to be born again
meaning.hi: और जन्म के लिए ही मरता है

meaning.en: all these are unstable
the doings of moving and unmoving beings
wicked, the footing of all calamities
things that are the grounds of wealth
like rods of iron
without contact with each other
things wither, each alone
by this imagining of the mind
distaste for things has come
meaning.hi: चीज़ों में अरुचि आ गई है

meaning.en: like a traveller's in deserts
how will this sorrow be calmed
so I am burning in mind
meaning.hi: ऐसे मैं मन से तप रहा हूँ

meaning.en: wheels of piled-up worries
riches are not for my joy
meaning.hi: धन मेरे आनन्द के लिए नहीं

meaning.en: with wives who have borne children
homes like those of fierce calamities
this, standing here, seemingly generous
utterly fragile in the world
fortune, O sage, is for bewilderment
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, लक्ष्मी मोह के लिए है

meaning.en: she too surely gives no real comfort
meaning.hi: वह भी निश्चय ही सुख देने वाली नहीं

meaning.en: life-span
fragile as a drop hanging from a leaf's tip
meaning.hi: पत्ते की नोक पर लटकी बूँद जैसी क्षणभंगुर

meaning.en: like a madman, abandoning
I may go, leaving this little body untimely
meaning.hi: मैं असमय इस छोटे शरीर को छोड़ जाऊँ

meaning.en: feeding on sense-objects
of those whose minds are worn out by clinging to poison
meaning.hi: विष-रूपी आसक्ति से जर्जर चित्त वालों की

meaning.en: of those whose discernment of Self is immature
life is a cause of weariness
wrapping up the wind is possible
and cutting up the sky
and knotting the waves
trust in life-span is not fitting
by which the attainable is attained
after which one grieves no more
meaning.hi: जिसके बाद फिर शोक नहीं होता

meaning.en: the abode of supreme contentment
that is called life
even trees live
animals and birds live
he lives whose mind
lives by reflection
only they are born in the world
creatures who have lived well
meaning.hi: जिन प्राणियों ने अच्छा जीवन जिया

meaning.en: who are not born here again
meaning.hi: जो यहाँ फिर जन्म नहीं लेते

meaning.en: the rest are old donkeys
scripture is a burden to one without discernment
meaning.hi: विवेकहीन के लिए शास्त्र बोझ है

meaning.en: knowledge is a burden to the passionate
meaning.hi: आसक्त के लिए ज्ञान बोझ है

meaning.en: mind is a burden to the restless
meaning.hi: अशान्त के लिए मन बोझ है

meaning.en: the body is a burden to one who knows not the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा को न जानने वाले के लिए शरीर बोझ है

meaning.en: calamity through the sway of ego
from ego, dreadful mental torments
through ego, craving and striving
no enemy greater than ego
meaning.hi: अहंकार से बड़ा कोई शत्रु नहीं

meaning.en: under the sway of ego
whatever moving or unmoving I enjoyed
all of that is unreal
the real is freedom from ego
this way and that, very agitated
runs about in vain
the mind goes further away
meaning.hi: मन और दूर चला जाता है

meaning.en: like a dog in a village
brought to dullness by the cruel one
by one who follows his wife Craving
meaning.hi: तृष्णा रूपी पत्नी के अनुगामी द्वारा

meaning.en: controlled as if by a dog
O wise one, I am abandoned by my mind
meaning.hi: हे ब्रह्मन्, मन ने मुझे छोड़ दिया है

meaning.en: than even drinking the great ocean
than even uprooting Sumeru
than even eating fire
restraining the mind is harder
the mind is the cause of objects
when it exists, the three worlds exist
meaning.hi: उसके होने पर तीनों लोक हैं

meaning.en: when it wanes, the world wanes
meaning.hi: उसके क्षीण होने पर जगत क्षीण

meaning.en: it must be treated with effort
meaning.hi: उसका यत्न से उपचार करना चाहिए

meaning.en: whatever, O best of sages, I
take refuge in, the wealth of virtues
meaning.hi: गुणों की सम्पदा का आश्रय लेता हूँ

meaning.en: my craving cuts each one
meaning.hi: उस-उस को मेरी तृष्णा काट देती है

meaning.en: as a little mouse a string
sets foot even where no leap can reach
meaning.hi: अलंघ्य पर भी पाँव रखती है

meaning.en: even when satisfied, strives in vain
meaning.hi: तृप्त होकर भी व्यर्थ चेष्टा करती है

meaning.en: does not stay long in one place
meaning.hi: देर तक एक जगह नहीं टिकती

meaning.en: craving is a fickle she-monkey
one moment comes to the underworld
meaning.hi: क्षण में पाताल में आती है

meaning.en: one moment goes to the sky
meaning.hi: क्षण में आकाश में जाती है

meaning.en: one moment wanders in the thickets of the directions
meaning.hi: क्षण में दिशाओं के कुंजों में घूमती है

meaning.en: craving is the bee of the heart-lotus
among all the sorrows of worldly life
craving alone gives long sorrow
meaning.hi: अकेली तृष्णा लम्बा दुख देने वाली

meaning.en: even one who dwells in the inner palace
throws into great danger
meaning.hi: अत्यन्त संकट में डाल देती है

meaning.en: the charm against the cholera of craving
is the giving up of worry, O twice-born
meaning.hi: हे द्विज, वह चिन्ता का त्याग है

meaning.en: by a little it comes to joy
meaning.hi: थोड़े से आनन्द को पाती है

meaning.en: by a little it comes to distress
meaning.hi: थोड़े से खेद को पाती है

meaning.en: nothing is as pitiable as the body
low
devoid of good qualities
the body
the great house of the householder Ego
meaning.hi: अहंकार रूपी गृहस्थ का बड़ा घर

meaning.en: let it fall or become stable
what is it to me, O teacher
with senses like cattle tied in a row
meaning.hi: कतार में बँधे इन्द्रिय रूपी पशुओं वाला

meaning.en: with a courtyard where craving prances
meaning.hi: जिसके आँगन में तृष्णा उछलती है

meaning.en: crowded with servants, the mind's thoughts
this body-house is not dear to me
occupied by the little monkey, the tongue
frightful with its doorway, the mouth
with teeth seen as bits of bone
meaning.hi: हड्डी के टुकड़ों जैसे दिखते दाँतों वाला

meaning.en: this body-house is not dear to me
of this, made of blood and flesh
outside and inside, O sage
whose one nature is destruction
tell me, what is the charm of the body
meaning.hi: बताइए, शरीर की रमणीयता क्या है

meaning.en: in lightning, in autumn clouds
meaning.hi: बिजली में, शरद के बादलों में

meaning.en: and in phantom cities in the sky
by whom stability has been found
let him trust in the body
in childhood, fear of the teacher
likewise of mother and father
meaning.hi: वैसे ही माता और पिता से

meaning.en: of people and of older children
meaning.hi: लोगों से और बड़े बच्चों से

meaning.en: childhood is a temple of fear
by one dwelling in the burrow of one's own mind
meaning.hi: अपने चित्त के बिल में रहने वाले से

meaning.en: by the maker of many delusions
meaning.hi: अनेक भ्रम पैदा करने वाले से

meaning.en: forcibly, by the demon of desire
one is overpowered, helpless
servants, sons and women
relatives and friends too
laugh as at a madman
at a man trembling with old age
long, full of wretchedness and faults
meaning.hi: दीनता और दोषों से भरी, लम्बी

meaning.en: longing grows in old age
the one friend of all calamities
giving burning in the heart
whatever this, found somewhere
meaning.hi: जो यह कहीं पाई जाती है

meaning.en: feeling of happiness in the world
reaching life as a clump of grass
meaning.hi: आयु को घास के गुच्छे की तरह पाकर

meaning.en: Time cuts that down too
meaning.hi: काल उसे भी काट देता है

meaning.en: grass, dust and great Indra
gold, Mount Meru and a mustard seed
meaning.hi: सोना, मेरु पर्वत और सरसों का दाना

meaning.en: set on making everything its own, to fill itself
meaning.hi: अपना पेट भरने के लिए सब कुछ अपना बना लेने को उद्यत

meaning.en: this Time destroys all; by it the three worlds are overrun
meaning.hi: यह काल सबका संहारक है; उसी से तीनों लोक दबे हैं

meaning.en: of this doll made of flesh
in a cage of limbs swaying as if run by a machine
meaning.hi: यन्त्र से हिलते अंगों के पिंजरे में

meaning.en: made up of sinews, bones and joints
meaning.hi: नसों, हड्डियों और जोड़ों से बनी

meaning.en: what in a woman is beautiful?
skin, flesh, blood, tears and fluids
meaning.hi: त्वचा, मांस, रक्त, आँसू और तरल

meaning.en: separating them out with the eyes
look closely - if it is lovely
meaning.hi: ध्यान से देखो - यदि सुन्दर हो

meaning.en: why are you deluded for nothing?
meaning.hi: व्यर्थ ही मोहित क्यों होते हो?

meaning.en: shining on the slopes of Meru's peak
meaning.hi: मेरु शिखर की ढलानों पर चमकती

meaning.en: like the swift, restless stream of the Ganga
meaning.hi: गंगा की तेज़, चंचल धारा के समान

meaning.en: on which, O sage, was seen
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, जिस पर देखी गई

meaning.en: the sparkling grace of a pearl necklace
meaning.hi: मोतियों के हार की चमकती शोभा

meaning.en: in cremation grounds at the far edges
that very bosom of the beloved
in time is eaten by dogs
meaning.hi: समय आने पर कुत्तों द्वारा खाया जाता है

meaning.en: like a small ball of rice
meaning.hi: चावल के छोटे कौर की तरह

meaning.en: wearing dark hair and kohl
meaning.hi: केश और काजल धारण करने वाली

meaning.en: hard to touch, dear to the eyes
meaning.hi: छूने में कठिन, आँखों को प्रिय

meaning.en: women are flames of the fire of wrongdoing
meaning.hi: स्त्रियाँ पाप की आग की लपटें हैं

meaning.en: they burn a man like grass
meaning.hi: पुरुष को तिनके की तरह जलाती हैं

meaning.en: burning even from very far off
meaning.hi: बहुत दूर से भी जलाने वाली

meaning.en: full of sweetness yet leaving one dry
meaning.hi: रस से भरी फिर भी रसहीन

meaning.en: women are the fuel of the fires of hell
meaning.hi: स्त्रियाँ नरक की आग का ईंधन हैं

meaning.en: lovely and terrible
by a hunter named Desire
spread out, for those of bewildered mind
meaning.hi: फैलाए गए, भ्रमित मन वालों के लिए

meaning.en: women, for the man-birds
nets that bind the limbs
of fish in the pond of birth
meaning.hi: जन्म रूपी तालाब की मछलियों का

meaning.en: moving in the mud of the mind
meaning.hi: मन के कीचड़ में घूमने वाली

meaning.en: for men, bad craving is the line
meaning.hi: पुरुषों के लिए बुरी वासना डोरी है

meaning.en: woman is the bait on the hook
meaning.hi: स्त्री काँटे पर लगा चारा है

meaning.en: of all the jewels of fault
with this fine little casket
with this chain of sorrow, always
meaning.hi: दुख की इस ज़ंजीर से, सदा

meaning.en: let me have done with woman
who has a wife has longing for pleasure
meaning.hi: जिसकी पत्नी है उसमें भोग की इच्छा है

meaning.en: for one without a wife, where is the ground of pleasure?
meaning.hi: पत्नी-रहित के लिए भोग की भूमि कहाँ?

meaning.en: giving up woman, the world is given up
meaning.hi: स्त्री को छोड़कर संसार छूट जाता है

meaning.en: giving up the world, one becomes happy
meaning.hi: संसार छोड़कर सुखी हो जाता है

meaning.en: even the directions are not seen
even a land comes to be called something else
meaning.hi: देश भी किसी और नाम से जाना जाने लगता है

meaning.en: even mountains crumble
even the stars decay
even the oceans dry up
even the Pole Star has an unfixed life
meaning.hi: ध्रुव का जीवन भी अस्थिर है

meaning.en: even perfected beings perish
demons and others waste away
meaning.hi: दानव आदि भी क्षीण होते हैं

meaning.en: even the steadfast Creator declines
meaning.hi: दृढ़ स्थिति वाले परमेष्ठी भी घटते हैं

meaning.en: even Hari, the unborn
even being comes to non-being
meaning.hi: भाव भी अभाव को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: the lords of the directions surely grow old
meaning.hi: दिशाओं के स्वामी भी निश्चय ही जीर्ण होते हैं

meaning.en: Brahma, Vishnu and Rudra
or all kinds of beings
run only toward destruction
meaning.hi: केवल विनाश की ओर दौड़ते हैं

meaning.en: like waters into the undersea fire
misfortunes come in a moment
meaning.hi: विपत्तियाँ पल भर में आती हैं

meaning.en: fortunes come in a moment
meaning.hi: सम्पत्तियाँ पल भर में आती हैं

meaning.en: a moment of birth, then death
meaning.hi: पल भर में जन्म, फिर मृत्यु

meaning.en: all that is surely perishable
heroes are slain by one who is no hero
meaning.hi: वीर अवीर के हाथों मारे जाते हैं

meaning.en: a hundred are killed even by one
meaning.hi: एक से भी सौ मारे जाते हैं

meaning.en: poison is the harshness of sense objects
meaning.hi: विषयों की विषमता ही विष है

meaning.en: what is called poison is not poison
meaning.hi: जिसे विष कहते हैं वह विष नहीं

meaning.en: sense objects kill across births
poison takes one life
thus, in my (mind) burnt by the wildfire of faults
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार दोषों की दावाग्नि से जले मेरे (मन में)

meaning.en: now, in the mind
hopes of pleasure no longer stir
meaning.hi: भोग की आशाएँ अब नहीं फड़कतीं

meaning.en: not even for mirage-lakes
meaning.hi: मृगतृष्णा के सरोवरों के लिए भी

meaning.en: therefore awaken me quickly
with knowledge of the truth, O teacher
if not, taking up silence
meaning.hi: यदि नहीं, तो मौन धारण करके

meaning.en: free of pride, envy gone
meditating on Vishnu in the mind
meaning.hi: मन में विष्णु का ध्यान करते हुए

meaning.en: like a figure set in a painting
meaning.hi: चित्र में अंकित आकृति के समान

words.sanskrit: nidagha tava na asti anyat jneyam

meaning.en: Nidagha, there is nothing else for you to know
meaning.hi: निदाघ, तुम्हारे लिए और कुछ जानने योग्य नहीं

meaning.en: O best of the wise
you know by an understanding blessed by God
meaning.hi: ईश्वर-कृपा से युक्त प्रज्ञा से तुम जानते हो

meaning.en: I wipe away the delusion born of a clouded mind
meaning.hi: मन की मलिनता से उपजा भ्रम मैं पोंछता हूँ

meaning.en: doorkeepers at the gate of liberation
four are proclaimed
calm, inquiry, contentment
the fourth, company of the good
even one, with all effort
meaning.hi: एक को भी, पूरे प्रयत्न से

meaning.en: giving up all else, one should take refuge in
when one is won over
meaning.hi: एक के वश में होने पर

meaning.en: all four come under control
meaning.hi: चारों भी वश में आ जाते हैं

meaning.en: by scriptures and, first, by contact with good people
meaning.hi: शास्त्रों से और पहले सज्जनों के सम्पर्क से

meaning.en: by austerity and self-control
at first, for release from worldly existence
meaning.hi: आरम्भ में, संसार से मुक्ति के लिए

meaning.en: one should grow wisdom above all
of one's own experience and of scripture
and of the teacher - their agreement
by the practice of which
by that the Self is constantly seen
meaning.hi: उससे आत्मा निरन्तर देखी जाती है

meaning.en: giving up the pursuit of plans and hopes
meaning.hi: संकल्पों और आशाओं के पीछा करने का त्याग

meaning.en: if you do so at every moment
that state of no-mind
you have surely reached, purifying
meaning.hi: पवित्र करने वाली, तुम पा ही चुके हो

meaning.en: the mind's not being the doer
that is called true settledness
that alone is the state of wholeness
that is the blessed, supreme peace
giving up completely with the mind
the notion of self in all things
remain just as you are
like one mute, blind and deaf
meaning.hi: गूँगे, अन्धे और बहरे के समान

meaning.en: all is still, unborn, one, without beginning or middle
meaning.hi: सब शान्त, अजन्मा, एक, आदि-मध्य से रहित

meaning.en: shining, only self-savouring, with no thinkable mark
meaning.hi: प्रकाशमान, केवल स्वानुभव, अचिन्त्य चिह्न वाला

words.sanskrit: sarvam prashantam iti shabdamayi cha drishtih

meaning.en: and the wordy view 'all is still'
meaning.hi: और 'सब शान्त है' - यह शब्दमयी दृष्टि

words.sanskrit: badhartham eva hi mudha eva tad om iti idam

meaning.en: is only for cancelling, else idle; that is Om, this
meaning.hi: केवल बाध के लिए, अन्यथा व्यर्थ; वह ॐ है, यह

meaning.en: you, with mind ever awake
even while doing the world's work
meaning.hi: संसार के काम करते हुए भी

meaning.en: having known the oneness of the Self
remain like an unstirred great ocean
meaning.hi: क्षोभ रहित महासागर की तरह रहो

meaning.en: that awakening to truth itself
is fire to the grass of cravings
meaning.hi: वासना रूपी घास की आग है

meaning.en: is what the word samadhi means
meaning.hi: समाधि शब्द से कहा गया है

meaning.en: not merely staying silent
when a gem is present, wanting nothing
as the world goes about its work
in the supreme reality that is mere being
meaning.hi: केवल सत्ता रूप परम तत्त्व में

meaning.en: just so is this mass of worlds
therefore in the Self there is doership
and non-doership too, O sage
being without desire, it is no doer
meaning.hi: इच्छा-रहित होने से वह अकर्ता है

meaning.en: a doer by mere presence
know these two to be in Brahman
meaning.hi: इन दोनों को ब्रह्म में जानो

meaning.en: doership and non-doership, O sage
where this very wonder is
resting on That, be steady
therefore, 'I am ever a non-doer'
with blazing conviction
that which is called the highest nectar
evenness alone remains
listen, Nidagha: those rooted in purity
born on earth, of great virtue
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी पर जन्मे, महान गुणों वाले

meaning.en: they are always risen and glad
meaning.hi: वे सदा उदित और प्रसन्न हैं

meaning.en: like moons in their own sky
meaning.hi: अपने आकाश में चन्द्रमाओं की तरह

meaning.en: they do not wilt in calamity
meaning.hi: विपत्ति में वे म्लान नहीं होते

meaning.en: as a golden lotus at night
meaning.hi: जैसे रात में सोने का कमल

meaning.en: they desire nothing beyond what is at hand
meaning.hi: प्राप्त के अतिरिक्त कुछ नहीं चाहते

meaning.en: they delight in the path of the wise
meaning.hi: शिष्टों के मार्ग में रमते हैं

meaning.en: they shine by their very presence
meaning.hi: अपने रूप से ही शोभित होते हैं

meaning.en: through friendliness and other virtues
meaning.hi: मैत्री आदि गुणों के व्यवहार से

meaning.en: even, of one taste, gentle one
always of good conduct
like the ocean, keeping their bounds
meaning.hi: समुद्र की तरह मर्यादा रखने वाले

meaning.en: they are of clear intent
meaning.hi: वे निर्मल आशय वाले होते हैं

meaning.en: they do not abandon their order
the great ones, like suns
'Who am I, and how is this?'
meaning.hi: 'मैं कौन हूँ, और यह कैसे है?'

meaning.en: the grime of worldly life spread wide
meaning.hi: दूर तक फैला संसार का मैल

meaning.en: should be inquired into with effort
by the wise, together with the good
one should not engage in wrong deeds
meaning.hi: अनुचित कर्मों में नहीं लगना चाहिए

meaning.en: one should not live with the ignoble
meaning.hi: अनार्य के साथ नहीं रहना चाहिए

meaning.en: the destroyer of all should be regarded
death, not with disregard
leaving aside the body, bones and flesh
meaning.hi: शरीर, हड्डी और मांस को छोड़कर

meaning.en: the unlovely blood and the rest
the thread of the pearl-string of beings
meaning.hi: प्राणी रूपी मोतियों की माला का धागा

meaning.en: one should behold pure consciousness
running after what seems worth having
wholly casting off what seems worth avoiding
this which is the mind's nature
meaning.hi: जो यह मन का रूप है

meaning.en: know it as external, nothing else
meaning.hi: उसे बाहरी जानो, और कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: by the path shown by teacher and scripture
meaning.hi: गुरु और शास्त्र के बताए मार्ग से

meaning.en: and by one's own experience, in the mass of consciousness
meaning.hi: और अपने अनुभव से, चैतन्य-घन में

meaning.en: knowing 'I am Brahman alone'
the sage becomes free of sorrow
a hundred falling swords to be borne like blows of lotuses
meaning.hi: सौ तेज़ तलवारों का गिरना कमलों की मार की तरह सहना

words.sanskrit: agnina daho hima-sechanam iva angara-vartanam chandana-charcha iva

meaning.en: burning like snow-sprinkling, rolling on coals like sandal paste
meaning.hi: आग का जलाना बर्फ़ के छिड़काव सा, अंगारों पर लोटना चन्दन-लेप सा

meaning.en: cutting off one's own head like sweet sleep
meaning.hi: अपना सिर कटना सुखद नींद की तरह

meaning.en: thus from firm dispassion awakening arises
meaning.hi: ऐसे दृढ़ वैराग्य से बोध होता है

meaning.en: arising from the teacher's words
by the purity of one's own experience and the rest
meaning.hi: अपने अनुभव आदि की शुद्धता से

meaning.en: by the practice of which
by that the Self is ever seen
meaning.hi: उससे आत्मा निरन्तर देखी जाती है

meaning.en: even for one whose confusion of direction is gone
meaning.hi: जिसका दिशा-भ्रम मिट गया उसके लिए भी

meaning.en: the direction appears as before
meaning.hi: दिशा पहले की तरह दिखती है

meaning.en: so, what knowledge has destroyed
reflect that the world does not exist
meaning.hi: संसार नहीं है, यह भावना करो

meaning.en: wealth does not help
nor friends nor relatives
nor wearing down the body, nor shelter at holy places
meaning.hi: न शरीर को कष्ट से घिसना, न तीर्थ-मन्दिरों का आश्रय

meaning.en: that state is reached through the mind alone
meaning.hi: वह पद केवल मन से ही पाया जाता है

meaning.en: whatever sorrows, whatever thirst
meaning.hi: जो भी दुख, जो भी तृष्णा

meaning.en: whatever unbearable anxieties
in the calm-minded, all of that
meaning.hi: शान्त मन वालों में वह सब

meaning.en: vanishes like darkness before the sun
meaning.hi: सूर्य के सामने अँधेरे की तरह मिट जाता है

meaning.en: they come to utmost (trust), as in a mother
meaning.hi: माता की तरह परम (विश्वास) को पाते हैं

meaning.en: the fierce and the gentle
all beings here come to trust
meaning.hi: यहाँ सब प्राणी विश्वास करते हैं

meaning.en: in one endowed with calm
not by drinking elixirs
nor by fortune's embrace
one does not gain such happiness
as a person does through inner calm
meaning.hi: जैसा मनुष्य भीतर की शान्ति से पाता है

meaning.en: having heard, touched and eaten
having seen and known the pleasant and unpleasant
who neither rejoices nor droops
meaning.hi: जो न हर्षित होता है न म्लान

meaning.en: he is called calm
clear as the disc of the cool-rayed moon
meaning.hi: शीतल किरणों वाले चन्द्र-बिम्ब सा निर्मल

meaning.en: whose mind is undisturbed
in death, festival and war
he is called calm
among ascetics and the learned
among sacrificing priests and kings
among the mighty and the virtuous
only the calm one shines
meaning.hi: शान्ति वाला ही शोभित होता है

meaning.en: by drinking the nectar of contentment
those who, calm, have become fulfilled
meaning.hi: जो शान्त होकर तृप्त हो गए

meaning.en: great souls who delight in the Self
they have reached the highest state
meaning.hi: वे महान पद को पा चुके हैं

meaning.en: letting go of what has not come
even-minded about what has come
meaning.hi: प्राप्त में समता को पाया हुआ

meaning.en: in whom neither distress nor its opposite is seen
meaning.hi: जिसमें न खेद दिखे न अखेद

meaning.en: is called contented
does not long for what has not come
enjoys what has come as it pleases
meaning.hi: प्राप्त का यथेच्छ भोग करता है

meaning.en: who is of gentle conduct
is called contented
the mind delights in what has come
like a faithful wife in the inner courtyard
meaning.hi: जैसे साध्वी अन्तःपुर के आँगन में

meaning.en: then liberation-in-life dawns
giving the bliss of one's true nature
as time allows, as scripture guides
meaning.hi: समय के अनुसार, शास्त्र के अनुसार

meaning.en: as place permits, as comfort suits
meaning.hi: स्थान के अनुसार, सुविधा के अनुसार

meaning.en: with good company where possible, this graded path to freedom
meaning.hi: यथासम्भव सत्संग के साथ, मोक्ष-मार्ग का यह क्रम

words.sanskrit: tavat vicharayet prajnah yavat vishrantim atmani

meaning.en: the wise should reflect until he rests in the Self
meaning.hi: बुद्धिमान तब तक विचार करे जब तक आत्मा में विश्राम न हो

meaning.en: for one settled in the rest of the fourth state
turned back from the ocean of becoming
meaning.hi: भव-सागर से लौटे हुए के लिए

meaning.en: whether living or not living
whether householder or renunciant
no aim in what is done or left undone
meaning.hi: न किए न अनकिए से प्रयोजन

meaning.en: nor in the tangles of scripture and tradition
like the ocean without the churning mountain
he remains as he is
pure knowing of the Self of all
when it rises as your own nature
meaning.hi: जब वह तुम्हारे स्वरूप के रूप में उदित होता है

meaning.en: it shines beyond space, direction and time
meaning.hi: वह विस्तार, दिशा और काल से परे चमकता है

meaning.en: with consciousness as its body
thus the Self, however and wherever
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार आत्मा, जैसे और जहाँ

meaning.en: has come to shine forth
quickly abides that way, there
meaning.hi: वहाँ शीघ्र वैसे ही स्थित होती है

meaning.en: and shines in that form
meaning.hi: और उसी रूप में शोभित होती है

meaning.en: all this that is seen
the world of the still and the moving
that, like a dream in deep sleep
meaning.hi: वह, सुषुप्ति में स्वप्न की तरह

meaning.en: vanishes at the end of the age
meaning.hi: कल्प के अन्त में नष्ट हो जाता है

meaning.en: Order, Self, the supreme Brahman
Truth and the like, by the wise
devised for everyday use
the names of that great Self
just as what the word 'bangle' means
has no being apart from gold
nor from the golden bangle
so what 'world' means is the Supreme
meaning.hi: वैसे ही 'जगत्' शब्द का अर्थ परम है

meaning.en: by that, this dazzling magic show
is spread across the world
the inner sense that seer and seen are real
meaning.hi: भीतर द्रष्टा और दृश्य की सत्यता

meaning.en: is called bondage
the seer is bound through the seen
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा दृश्य के वश से बँधा है

meaning.en: when the seen is absent, he is freed
meaning.hi: दृश्य के अभाव में मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: 'world', 'you', 'I' and so on
creation itself is called the seen
by the mind alone, this magic show
meaning.hi: केवल मन से यह इन्द्रजाल की शोभा

meaning.en: is spread across the world
as long as this goes on
so long there is no liberation
the universe is spread out by Brahma
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा द्वारा विश्व फैलाया जाता है

meaning.en: by the self-born one, through mind alone
so the universe is made of mind
whatever is seen
neither outside nor in the heart
does the mind exist as a real thing
that by which things appear
that is called the mind
know the mind as imagining
it is nothing apart from imagining
wherever imagining is, there
understand that mind is present
imagining and mind as separate
never, by anyone
meaning.hi: कभी नहीं, किसी के द्वारा नहीं

meaning.en: when the mass of imaginings has melted
one's own nature remains
in 'I', 'you', 'world' and the rest
when the whirl of the seen has calmed
meaning.hi: दृश्य के सम्भ्रम के शान्त होने पर

meaning.en: there is such a state of aloneness
when the seen has returned to being
meaning.hi: दृश्य के सत्ता में लीन होने पर

meaning.en: at the coming of the great dissolution
when it has gone into non-being
all that is seen, before creation
meaning.hi: सम्पूर्ण दृश्य, सृष्टि के आदि में

meaning.en: only peace remains
meaning.hi: केवल शान्त ही शेष रहता है

meaning.en: there is One, never setting, shining
meaning.hi: एक है, कभी अस्त न होने वाला, प्रकाशमान

meaning.en: unborn, divine, free from all ill
always doing all, being all
is called the Supreme Self
from which words turn back
meaning.hi: जहाँ से वाणी लौट आती है

meaning.en: who is known by the liberated
meaning.hi: जो मुक्तों द्वारा जाना जाता है

meaning.en: and whose names such as 'Self'
are assigned, not his own nature
the space of mind, the space of consciousness
and ordinary space, the third
know it to be emptier than the two
the space of consciousness, great sage
in passing from one place to another
meaning.hi: एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पहुँचने में

meaning.en: that which is the middle of awareness
in a blink, the space of consciousness
know that, best of sages
there, with all imaginings wholly cast off
meaning.hi: वहाँ, सब संकल्पों को पूरी तरह हटाकर

meaning.en: if you come to abide
the peaceful state that is the Self of all
then you will reach it, without doubt
risen generosity and beauty
full of the flavour of dispassion
this which flows with bliss
meaning.hi: जो यह आनन्द बहाने वाली है

meaning.en: is called samadhi
by understanding that the seen cannot truly be
meaning.hi: दृश्य के असम्भव होने के बोध से

meaning.en: when liking, disliking and the rest wear thin
meaning.hi: राग-द्वेष आदि के क्षीण होने पर

meaning.en: that delight which rises in strength
meaning.hi: वह आनन्द जो बल से उदित होता है

meaning.en: is called samadhi
understanding that the seen cannot be is knowledge
meaning.hi: दृश्य के असम्भव होने का बोध ही ज्ञान है

meaning.en: what is to be known is consciousness
that alone is wholeness
all else is false
the raging Airavata tied up
in a hollow at the corner of a mustard seed
meaning.hi: सरसों के दाने के कोने की खोह में

meaning.en: a war waged by a mosquito
with herds of lions in a dust-mote's hollow
meaning.hi: धूल-कण की खोह में सिंहों के झुण्डों से

meaning.en: Mount Meru set in a lotus seed
swallowed by a baby bee
meaning.hi: भौंरे के बच्चे द्वारा निगला गया

meaning.en: Nidagha, know it to be like that
this world, made of delusion
the mind itself is worldly existence
stained by passion and other torments
that same, freed from them
is called the end of becoming
being imagined through the mind
the embodied one becomes a body
freed from the habit of body-identity
is not stained by the body's traits
meaning.hi: देह के धर्मों से लिप्त नहीं होता

meaning.en: within, it turns an age into a moment
meaning.hi: भीतर कल्प को क्षण बना देता है

meaning.en: and stretches a moment into an age
meaning.hi: और क्षण को कल्प बना देता है

meaning.en: worldly existence is the mind's play
this is my firm conviction
not one who has not turned from wrongdoing
meaning.hi: न वह जो दुराचार से विरत नहीं

meaning.en: not the restless, not the unfocused
nor one whose mind is unsettled
can reach this by cleverness
meaning.hi: प्रज्ञा से इसे पा सकता है

meaning.en: that bliss of Brahman, beyond opposites
without qualities, a mass of truth and consciousness
knowing it as one's own Self
one never fears
beyond the highest, greater than the great
meaning.hi: परे से परे, महान से महान

meaning.en: eternal, radiant by nature, auspicious
meaning.hi: स्वरूप के तेज से युक्त, शाश्वत, शिव

meaning.en: the seer, the ancient, eternal Person
Lord of all, worshipped by all gods
the settled conviction 'I am Brahman'
is the cause of liberation for great souls
meaning.hi: महात्माओं के मोक्ष का कारण है

words.sanskrit: dve pade bandha-mokshaya nirmama iti mama iti cha

meaning.en: two words for bondage and freedom: 'not mine' and 'mine'
meaning.hi: बन्धन-मोक्ष के दो पद: 'मेरा नहीं' और 'मेरा'

words.sanskrit: mama iti badhyate jantuh nirmama iti vimuchyate

meaning.en: by 'mine' one is bound, by 'not mine' freed
meaning.hi: 'मेरा' से बँधता है, 'मेरा नहीं' से मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: in forms like soul and Lord, conscious and unconscious
meaning.hi: जीव-ईश्वर आदि रूप से, चेतन-अचेतन रूप

meaning.en: from the first glance to the entering-in
creation is imagined by the Lord
worldly life, from waking to release, is imagined by the soul
meaning.hi: जाग्रत से मोक्ष तक का संसार जीव-कल्पित है

meaning.en: from the Trinachiketa rite up to Yoga
rest on a confusion about the Lord
from the materialists up to Sankhya
rest on a confusion about the soul
therefore, by those seeking liberation
the mind should not be set on debates about soul and Lord
meaning.hi: जीव-ईश्वर के वादों में मति नहीं लगानी चाहिए

meaning.en: but rather the truth of Brahman
should be inquired into steadily
who sees all things without distinction
meaning.hi: जो सबको बिना भेद देखता है

meaning.en: by tracing consciousness through it all
he alone is the true knower
he is Shiva, Hari and the Creator
meaning.hi: वह शिव, वह हरि, वह विधि है

meaning.en: giving up sense objects is hard to gain
seeing the truth is hard to gain
the natural state is hard to gain
without a true teacher's compassion
in whom the power of awakening has risen
meaning.hi: जिसमें बोध की शक्ति उत्पन्न हुई है

meaning.en: who has let go of all works entirely
meaning.hi: जिसने सब कर्म पूरी तरह त्याग दिए

meaning.en: for such a yogi, the natural state
arises all by itself
meaning.hi: अपने आप ही उत्पन्न होती है

meaning.en: when indeed this one, in That
a person sees even a slight gap
meaning.hi: मनुष्य थोड़ा सा भी अन्तर देखता है

meaning.en: then fear arises for him
there is no doubt of this
the all-pervading being-consciousness-bliss
the eye of knowledge beholds
the eye of ignorance does not see
as a blind man the blazing sun
that Brahman is pure knowing itself
marked by truth and awareness
thus by fully knowing Brahman alone
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार केवल ब्रह्म के पूर्ण ज्ञान से

meaning.en: the mortal becomes immortal
the knot of the heart is untied
meaning.hi: हृदय की गाँठ खुल जाती है

meaning.en: all doubts are cut away
and his karmas wear away
meaning.hi: और उसके कर्म क्षीण होते हैं

meaning.en: when That, highest and lowest, is seen
meaning.hi: जब वह पर-अवर देखा जाता है

meaning.en: dropping identity with what is not the Self
unmoved amid the world's going on
settled within by single-minded devotion
be wholly given to pure awareness
meaning.hi: केवल संवित् के प्रति समर्पित हो

meaning.en: all the water in a desert
is only the desert itself
all these three worlds
are consciousness alone, by one's own inquiry
meaning.hi: अपने विचार से केवल चैतन्य हैं

meaning.en: letting go of the idea of target and non-target
who abides as the Self alone
meaning.hi: जो केवल आत्मा रूप से स्थित रहे

meaning.en: is Shiva himself, directly
the finest of the knowers of Brahman
the ground of all, beyond compare
out of reach of speech and mind
eternal, all-embracing, everywhere
supremely subtle, that is imperishable
of the almighty Great Lord
mind and world are indeed the play
meaning.hi: मन और जगत् विलास ही हैं

meaning.en: and by restraint and its lack
come worldly existence and peace
meaning.hi: संसार और शान्ति को पाता है

meaning.en: to cure the sickness of the mind
meaning.hi: मन के रोग की चिकित्सा के लिए

meaning.en: I tell you a remedy
whatever thing one holds dear
meaning.hi: जो-जो वस्तु अपने को प्रिय हो

meaning.en: giving it up, one reaches liberation
in one's own hands, wholly good
the act of giving up what one wants
meaning.hi: अपनी चाही वस्तु के त्याग का अनुभव

meaning.en: for whom this has become hard
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए यह कठिन हो गया

meaning.en: shame on that worm of a man
meaning.hi: धिक्कार है उस कीड़े-से मनुष्य को

meaning.en: achievable only by one's own effort
in the form of giving up one's wants
meaning.hi: अपनी इच्छित वस्तु के त्याग रूप

meaning.en: without simply calming the mind
meaning.hi: केवल मन की शान्ति के बिना

meaning.en: there is no path to good
with the sword of not-imagining
when this mind has been cut down
meaning.hi: जब यह मन काट दिया जाता है

meaning.en: everything, all-pervading, at peace
then becomes Brahman
be free of becoming by right reflection
meaning.hi: भावना से भव से मुक्त हो

meaning.en: free by the highest understanding
undistracted, hold fast to the Self
meaning.hi: अव्यग्र होकर आत्मा को धारण करो

meaning.en: the abode of consciousness that has swallowed the mind
meaning.hi: चित् का पद, जिसमें मन निगला गया

meaning.en: relying on the highest effort
bringing the mind to no-mind
meaning.hi: मन को अचित्तता तक ले जाकर

meaning.en: by meditation in the heart's space
in consciousness, with consciousness's whirling blade
meaning.hi: चित् में, चित्-चक्र की धार से

meaning.en: slay the mind
without hesitation
they bind you
no enemies
'this is he, this is I, that is mine'
meaning.hi: 'यह वह है, मैं यह हूँ, वह मेरा है'

meaning.en: the mind is only this much
simply by not dwelling on that
meaning.hi: केवल उसकी भावना न करने से

meaning.en: it is cut away as by a sickle
meaning.hi: हँसिये से कटा-सा विलीन हो जाता है

meaning.en: a torn mass of clouds in the sky
meaning.hi: आकाश में टूटा बादलों का समूह

meaning.en: as it is swept off in autumn
meaning.hi: जैसे शरद में उड़ा दिया जाता है

meaning.en: by that same kind of wind
so the mind within is blown away
meaning.hi: वैसे ही भीतर मन उड़ जाता है

meaning.en: let the winds at the end of the age blow
let the oceans merge into one
let the twelve suns blaze
the mind-free one suffers no harm
won by not-imagining alone
granting every fulfilment
in the great empire of not-imagining
stand firmly in that state
meaning.hi: उस पद को दृढ़ता से थामकर स्थित रहो

meaning.en: not without restlessness
is a mind seen anywhere
restlessness is the mind's nature
as heat is the nature of fire
meaning.hi: जैसे उष्णता अग्नि का धर्म है

meaning.en: this, the power of restless vibration
rooted in being its storehouse
know it as the power of the mind
whose nature is the world's grand show
meaning.hi: जिसका स्वभाव जगत् का आडम्बर है

meaning.en: but that which is free of restlessness
meaning.hi: पर जो चंचलता से रहित है

meaning.en: that mind is called the deathless
that alone is austerity
in the scriptures' conclusion it is called liberation
this restlessness of the mind
is ignorance made of cravings
that which is also called craving
destroy it through inquiry
by one's own determined effort
whatever state the mind is yoked to
meaning.hi: मन जिस पद में जोड़ा जाता है

meaning.en: reaching that state
be free of wavering, sinless one
so, relying on your own effort
overpowering the mind by the mind
meaning.hi: मन को मन से वश में करके

meaning.en: taking hold of the sorrowless state
be fearless and steady
the mind alone is capable
of firmly restraining the mind
could one who is no king be able
meaning.hi: क्या राजा न होने वाला समर्थ हो

meaning.en: to subdue a king
meaning.hi: राजा को वश में करने में

meaning.en: for those seized by the crocodile of craving
meaning.hi: तृष्णा रूपी ग्राह से पकड़े गए

meaning.en: fallen into the ocean of worldly life
swept far off by whirlpools
one's own mind is the boat
cutting the mind with the mind itself
meaning.hi: मन से ही मन को काटकर

meaning.en: the noose, the greatest bond
carry yourself across becoming
meaning.hi: स्वयं को भव से पार उतारो

meaning.en: no one is ferried across by another
meaning.hi: वह दूसरे द्वारा पार नहीं कराया जाता

meaning.en: whatever craving arises called 'mind'
meaning.hi: 'मन' नाम से जो-जो वासना उठती है

meaning.en: leaving its scent within
the wise should let go of each one
then ignorance wears away
letting go of craving for pleasure alone
give up the habit of seeing difference
then giving up 'is' and 'is not'
meaning.hi: फिर भाव और अभाव को छोड़कर

meaning.en: free of wavering, be happy
this alone is the ending of the mind
and this alone the ending of ignorance
meaning.hi: और यही अविद्या का नाश है

meaning.en: whatever is experienced
meaning.hi: जो कुछ भी अनुभव होता है

meaning.en: giving up leaning on it
not leaning on anything, indeed
is nirvana
sorrow is
holding on to things for support
ignorance, as though existing
is seen in those whose wisdom is lost
its form granted only in name
meaning.hi: जिसका आकार केवल नाम से स्वीकृत है

meaning.en: for the clear-sighted, where is it?
for so long, over the cliffs of worldly life
meaning.hi: तब तक संसार की कगारों पर

meaning.en: the embodied one, with his very self
it swings without a break
on those full of thorns of sorrow
meaning.hi: दुख के काँटों से भरी हुई पर

meaning.en: as long as this ignorance is his
meaning.hi: जब तक उसकी यह अविद्या है

meaning.en: not yet arisen, the destroyer
meaning.hi: नाश करने वाली उत्पन्न नहीं हुई

meaning.en: the spontaneous wish to see the Self
meaning.hi: स्वयं आत्मा को देखने की इच्छा

meaning.en: which wipes out delusion
meaning.hi: जो मोह का पूरा नाश करती है

meaning.en: for those who look beyond it
meaning.hi: इसके पार देखने वालों के लिए

meaning.en: it brings about its own ruin
when all-pervading awareness is seen
it melts away by itself
meaning.hi: वह अपने आप विलीन हो जाती है

meaning.en: this ignorance is nothing but desire
its ending is called liberation
and that, by not imagining alone
is achieved, O sage
even a little, in the sky of the mind
meaning.hi: मन के आकाश में थोड़ा भी

meaning.en: when the night of craving wanes
meaning.hi: वासना की रात के क्षीण होने पर

meaning.en: the darkness grows thin
as the sun of consciousness shines
meaning.hi: चेतना रूपी सूर्य के प्रकाश से

meaning.en: never sinking into its objects
common to all and everywhere
that principle of consciousness beyond words
that is the Self, the Supreme Lord
all this is truly Brahman
meaning.hi: यह सब निश्चय ही ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: eternal, solid consciousness, undamaged
another imagining called 'mind'
meaning.hi: मन नाम की कोई अन्य कल्पना

meaning.en: does not exist at all
nothing is born, nothing dies
meaning.hi: न जन्मता है, न मरता है

meaning.en: anything here in the three worlds
meaning.hi: यहाँ तीनों लोकों में कुछ भी

meaning.en: nor of the changes of things
is there real existence anywhere
the One alone, shining as alone
common to all, undamaged
never sinking into its objects
only pure consciousness exists here
in that eternal, all-spread, pure
in pure consciousness, untroubled
peaceful, a vast even calm
meaning.hi: शान्त, सम शान्ति के विस्तार में

meaning.en: unchanging, whose self is awareness

words.sanskrit: ya esha svabhava-abhimatam svayam sankalpya dhavati

meaning.en: which imagines what pleases it and runs after it
meaning.hi: जो अपने को भाने वाली चीज़ की कल्पना कर दौड़ती है

meaning.en: consciousness as object, itself unfaded
from thinking it is called mind

words.sanskrit: atah sankalpa-siddha iyam sankalpena eva nashyati

meaning.en: so, born of imagining, it is destroyed by imagining alone
meaning.hi: अतः संकल्प से बना यह संकल्प से ही नष्ट होता है

words.sanskrit: na aham brahma iti sankalpat su-dridhat

meaning.en: through the firm notion 'I am not Brahman'
meaning.hi: 'मैं ब्रह्म नहीं' इस दृढ़ संकल्प से

meaning.en: the mind is bound
through the firm notion 'all is Brahman'
meaning.hi: 'सब ब्रह्म है' इस दृढ़ संकल्प से

meaning.en: the mind is freed
'I am thin, I am bound by sorrow'
meaning.hi: 'मैं दुबला हूँ, मैं दुख से बँधा हूँ'

meaning.en: 'I am one with hands, feet and so on'
in line with such feelings
by living so, one is bound

words.sanskrit: na aham duhkhi na me dehah

meaning.en: 'I am not unhappy, the body is not mine'
what bondage for one resting in the Self?
meaning.hi: आत्मा में स्थित के लिए कौन सा बन्धन?

meaning.en: in line with such feelings
by living so, one is freed

words.sanskrit: na aham mamsam na cha asthini

meaning.en: 'I am not flesh, nor bones'
'I am other than the body, the Supreme'
one who is certain of this within
with ignorance worn thin, is freed
this ignorance is something imagined
from taking the not-Self as Self

words.sanskrit: param paurusham ashritya yatnat paramaya dhiya

meaning.en: relying on highest effort, care and understanding
meaning.hi: परम पुरुषार्थ, यत्न और परम बुद्धि के आश्रय से

words.sanskrit: bhoga-iccham duratah tyaktva nirvikalpah sukhi bhava

meaning.en: casting off desire for pleasure, be free and happy
meaning.hi: भोगेच्छा दूर छोड़कर निर्विकल्प, सुखी हो

meaning.en: my son, my wealth
I am he, this is mine
meaning.hi: मैं वह हूँ, यह मेरा है

meaning.en: thus, by this magic show
craving alone dances about

words.sanskrit: ma bhava ajnah bhava jnah tvam

meaning.en: do not be ignorant, be a knower
kill off the sense that worldly life is real
taking the not-Self for the Self
why do you weep like one who does not know?
meaning.hi: अज्ञानी की तरह क्यों रोते हो?

meaning.en: what is this dull, speechless thing to you
meaning.hi: यह जड़, मूक तुम्हारा क्या है

meaning.en: the body, made of flesh, impure
for whose sake, by pleasure and pain
you are helplessly beaten down
meaning.hi: तुम असहाय होकर पराजित होते हो

meaning.en: ah, how strange!

words.sanskrit: yat satyam brahma tad vismritam nrinam

meaning.en: Brahman, the truth, is forgotten by people
meaning.hi: जो सत्य ब्रह्म है वह मनुष्यों ने भुला दिया

meaning.en: while you are engaged in your work
meaning.hi: जब तुम कार्यों में लगे हो

meaning.en: let there be no colouring by attachment
ah, how strange!
mountains bound with threads from lotus stalks
meaning.hi: कमल से निकले धागों से बँधे पर्वत

meaning.en: that ignorance which does not exist
by it the universe is laid waste
now I shall explain something more
listen, dear one, point by point
the ground of ignorance has seven steps
the ground of knowledge too has seven steps
meaning.hi: ज्ञान-भूमि के भी सात ही पद हैं

meaning.en: countless steps in between
arise variously between these two
meaning.hi: इन दोनों के बीच अन्य रूप से उठते हैं

meaning.en: resting in one's own nature is liberation
slipping from it is the sense of 'I'
meaning.hi: उससे गिरना अहंभाव का अनुभव है

meaning.en: of the pure awareness of mere being
those who do not move from their nature
states like passion and aversion
for them ignorance is not possible
slipping away from one's own nature
consciousness sinking into its objects
any delusion other than this
has never been and will never be
when the mind moves from one object to another
meaning.hi: जब मन एक विषय से दूसरे पर जाता है

meaning.en: the state in between
with the shape of thinking dissolved
meaning.hi: जिसमें मनन का आकार नष्ट है

meaning.en: is called resting in one's nature
with every imagining stilled
the state that stands firm like a rock
free of both waking and sleep
that is the highest resting in one's nature
when the 'I' part is wounded and stilled
meaning.hi: अहन्ता-अंश के क्षत और शान्त होने पर

meaning.en: the mind no longer quivering with separateness
that which, alive and not dull, carries on
that is called one's true nature
seed-waking, then waking
and likewise great waking
waking-dream, then dream
dream-waking and deep sleep
thus is the sevenfold delusion
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार सात प्रकार का मोह

meaning.en: these also blend with one another
meaning.hi: फिर ये आपस में मिल जाते हैं

meaning.en: into countless forms
now hear the marks of each
that first stirring of awareness
nameless and spotless, of pure consciousness
meaning.hi: शुद्ध चित् की, अनाम और निर्मल

meaning.en: of the future 'mind', 'soul' and the rest
the container of names, words and meanings
meaning.hi: नाम, शब्द और अर्थ का पात्र

meaning.en: waking that exists only as a seed
that is called seed-waking
this is the first state of knowing
meaning.hi: यह ज्ञप्ति की नई अवस्था है

meaning.en: now hear of the waking state
for one newly born from the Supreme
meaning.hi: परम से नए उत्पन्न के लिए

meaning.en: 'this is I' and 'this is mine'
that simple, fresh notion
is waking, having no earlier notions behind it
meaning.hi: पूर्व भावना के अभाव से वह जाग्रत है

meaning.en: 'this is he, I am he, that is mine'
meaning.hi: 'यह वह है, मैं वह हूँ, वह मेरा है'

meaning.en: carried over from other births
that thick, heavy notion is called
clearly, great waking
whether loosely held or firmly rooted
wholly made of that imagining
the mind-kingdom of one awake
that is called waking-dream
two moons, silver in mother-of-pearl
through false distinctions like the mirage
once they become habitual
that waking-dream takes many forms
meaning.hi: वह जाग्रत-स्वप्न नाना प्रकार का होता है

meaning.en: 'I saw this only for a short while'
'and it is not real'
about which the one who has woken reflects
meaning.hi: जिस पर जागे हुए का विचार होता है

meaning.en: that is called dream
because clear seeing has long been absent
meaning.hi: लम्बे समय तक सम्यक् दर्शन के अभाव से

meaning.en: unopened and far-reaching
but going on for a long time
meaning.hi: पर लम्बे समय तक चलता हुआ

meaning.en: a dream arising as if it were waking
it is called dream-waking
flashing up even while awake
the leaving behind of all six states
that dull state of the individual soul
still loaded with seeds of sorrow to come
meaning.hi: भावी दुख के बोध से भरी

meaning.en: that condition is called deep sleep
the world, in that state
melts into an inner darkness
meaning.hi: भीतरी अन्धकार में लीन होता है

meaning.en: these seven states have been told by me
of knowing, O twice-born
each one here is of a hundred kinds
meaning.hi: यहाँ हर एक सौ प्रकार की

meaning.en: appearing in many forms
this seven-step ground of knowledge
meaning.hi: इस सात पदों वाली ज्ञान-भूमि को

meaning.en: listen, sinless one
once this is known, never again
meaning.hi: इसे जान लेने पर फिर नहीं

meaning.en: does one sink into the mud of delusion
meaning.hi: मोह के कीचड़ में डूबता है

meaning.en: from practising the four stages
that subtle art of staying untouched
full of the wonder of rooted purity
is called non-attachment
from practising the five stages
through firm delight in one's own Self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा में दृढ़ रमण से

meaning.en: of inner and outer
through not dwelling on objects
through long effort, prompted by others
meaning.hi: दूसरों द्वारा प्रेरित लम्बे प्रयत्न से

meaning.en: awakening
named 'not dwelling on objects'
the sixth stage arises
from long practice of the six stages
meaning.hi: छह भूमिकाओं के दीर्घ अभ्यास से

meaning.en: from no longer perceiving difference
resting solely in one's own nature
know that as the passage into the Fourth
this, in those liberated while living
exists as the Fourth state
meaning.hi: तुर्य अवस्था के रूप में है

meaning.en: belonging to liberation beyond the body
beyond this is the state beyond the Fourth
those greatly blessed ones, Nidagha
who have reached the seventh stage
great souls who delight in the Self
have attained the highest state
meaning.hi: वे महान पद को प्राप्त हुए

meaning.en: those liberated while living do not sink
into the flavours of pleasure and pain
with the work that naturally comes
they may do something, or not
the good ones, roused by those near them
meaning.hi: पास वालों द्वारा जगाए गए सज्जन

meaning.en: handed down through earlier custom
meaning.hi: पूर्व आचार के क्रम से आया

meaning.en: they carry out the customary conduct
meaning.hi: आचार का पालन करते ही हैं

meaning.en: rising like one woken from sleep
and these seven stages
are within reach of the wise alone
reaching this state of knowledge
even animals, foreigners and others
whether with a body or without
they are liberated, no doubt of it
meaning.hi: वे मुक्त हैं, इसमें संशय नहीं

meaning.en: knowledge is the cutting of the knot
meaning.hi: ज्ञप्ति ही ग्रन्थि का छेदन है

meaning.en: when that is present, there is freedom
the notion of water in a mirage and the like
meaning.hi: मृगतृष्णा में जल की बुद्धि आदि

meaning.en: this is simply their calming
but those who have crossed the sea of delusion
meaning.hi: पर जो मोह-सागर से पार हुए

meaning.en: have reached the highest state
they remain in these stages
meaning.hi: वे इन भूमिकाओं में स्थित हैं

meaning.en: wholly devoted to gaining the Self
the means of calming the mind
meaning.hi: मन को शान्त करने का उपाय

meaning.en: is called yoga
know it as having seven stages
and those stages have been described
but of these stages
the goal is the state called Brahman
meaning.hi: गन्तव्य ब्रह्म नाम का पद है

meaning.en: where there is no 'you-ness', 'I-ness' or selfhood
and no otherness at all
nowhere any imagining of existence
not within the range of 'is' and 'is not'
all at peace, resting on nothing
abiding like the sky, eternal, auspicious
free of ill, without appearance
nameless and causeless

words.sanskrit: na sat na asat na madhya-antam

meaning.en: neither being nor non-being, neither middle nor end
meaning.hi: न सत्, न असत्, न मध्य-अन्त

meaning.en: not 'everything', yet everything itself
beyond the grasp of mind and speech
fuller than the full, happier than happiness
meaning.hi: पूर्ण से पूर्ण, सुख से सुख

meaning.en: beyond experiencing objects, wholly at peace
the knowing of the Self spread everywhere
the existence of all things
is nothing other than awareness
where seer and seen come together
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा और दृश्य के सम्बन्ध में

meaning.en: the very form of the seeing in between
meaning.hi: बीच में जो दृष्टि का स्वरूप है

meaning.en: free of seer, seeing and seen
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा, दर्शन, दृश्य आदि से रहित

meaning.en: that is this state
when the mind travels from place to place
meaning.hi: मन के एक स्थान से दूसरे पर जाने पर

meaning.en: whatever the mind's form is in between
meaning.hi: बीच में जो मन का रूप है

meaning.en: an awareness alive, not dull
be one with that, always
of one beyond waking, dream and sleep
that eternal form of yours
not grasping objects, yet not dull
be one with that, always
leaving out only the dullness
that is like the heart of a rock
that whose nature is free of mind - be one with it always
meaning.hi: जो अमनस्क-स्वरूप है, सदा उसमें तन्मय हो

words.sanskrit: chittam dure parityajya yo'si so'si sthiro bhava

meaning.en: cast the mind away; be what you are, be steady
meaning.hi: मन को दूर छोड़कर, जो हो वही रहो, स्थिर हो

meaning.en: first the mind arose from the supreme reality of the Self
meaning.hi: पहले परमात्म-तत्त्व से मन उदित हुआ

meaning.en: by it this world was spread out with its net of alternatives
meaning.hi: उससे विकल्प-जाल सहित यह जगत् फैला

words.sanskrit: shunyena shunyam api vipra yatha ambarena

meaning.en: as, O learned one, emptiness upon emptiness in the sky
meaning.hi: जैसे, हे विप्र, आकाश में शून्य पर शून्य

meaning.en: blueness shines, bearing a lovely name
meaning.hi: सुन्दर नाम वाला नीलापन चमकता है

meaning.en: when the mind melts through the end of imagining
meaning.hi: संकल्प-क्षय से मन के गलने पर

meaning.en: the mists of worldly delusion melt away
meaning.hi: संसार-मोह का कोहरा गल जाता है

words.sanskrit: svaccham vibhati sharadi iva kham agatayam

meaning.en: it shines clear, like the sky in autumn
meaning.hi: शरद में आकाश की तरह निर्मल चमकता है

words.sanskrit: chin-matram ekam ajam adyam anantam antah

meaning.en: pure consciousness, one, unborn, first, endless, within
meaning.hi: भीतर एक, अज, आद्य, अनन्त चिन्मात्र

meaning.en: with no maker and no paint
a picture arisen in the sky
with no one viewing it, known by itself
a vision neither of sleep nor of dream
meaning.hi: न निद्रा न स्वप्न का दर्शन

meaning.en: in the witness, even and spotless
in the Self of consciousness, free of wavering
the worlds are reflected without any wish
meaning.hi: लोक बिना इच्छा के प्रतिबिम्बित होते हैं

meaning.en: as in a mirror
Brahman is one, the space of consciousness
the Self of all, unbroken
reflect on this with steady effort
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार प्रयत्न से भावना करो

meaning.en: to still the restlessness of the mind
meaning.hi: मन की चंचलता की शान्ति के लिए

meaning.en: patterned with lines and fine streaks
as a single massive rock
so, patterned with the three worlds
see the one Brahman here
since there is no second cause
this world was never born
what had to be known is now known
the wonder to be seen has been seen
long weary, I am now at rest
meaning.hi: लम्बे समय से थका मैं अब विश्रान्त हूँ

meaning.en: there is nothing apart from pure consciousness
see, doubt has come to rest
all restless curiosity gone
with the net of imaginings thrown off
the state beyond mind is the highest
they alone have reached true greatness
meaning.hi: वे ही भूमा को प्राप्त हुए

meaning.en: with every wrong stilled
the great-minded and calm-minded
who have gone beyond the mind
for the one who has truly inquired
meaning.hi: विचार कर चुके जीव के लिए

meaning.en: whose mental movements are dropping away
of one who keeps giving up thinking
whose mind has ripened somewhat
who is letting go of the seen
who knows what to reject and what to accept
meaning.hi: हेय और उपादेय को जानने वाले का

meaning.en: who always sees the Seer
meaning.hi: जो सदा द्रष्टा को देखता है

meaning.en: who sees nothing that is not the Seer
in the supreme reality to be known
who lives wide awake
asleep to the delusion about wealth
meaning.hi: धन के मोह के प्रति सोए हुए का

meaning.en: on the path of worldly life
through fully ripened dispassion
the same toward the flavourless and the flavourful
when the net of worldly cravings
has now been torn like a fowler's net
meaning.hi: पक्षी-जाल की तरह अब टूट गया हो

meaning.en: when the knot of the heart is loosened
by the force of dispassion
on adding the clearing-nut
as water turns clear
so, through the power of knowledge
meaning.hi: वैसे ही विज्ञान के बल से

meaning.en: one's true nature becomes clear
free of passion, free of clinging
beyond opposites, leaning on nothing
the mind flies out of delusion
meaning.hi: मन मोह से निकल जाता है

meaning.en: like a bird out of its cage
with the torment of doubt quietened
with the whirl of curiosity gone
the mind, full within
shines like the full moon
meaning.hi: पूर्ण चन्द्र की तरह शोभित होता है

words.sanskrit: na aham na cha anyat asti iha

meaning.en: there is no 'I' here, nor anything else
meaning.hi: यहाँ न मैं है, न अन्य

meaning.en: I am Brahman alone, free of all ill
thus, from between being and non-being
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार सत्-असत् के मध्य से

meaning.en: one who sees so, truly sees
meaning.hi: जो देखता है वही देखता है

meaning.en: on things that come without effort
on the sights before the eye
meaning.hi: आँख के सामने के दृश्यों पर

meaning.en: as the mind falls without craving
meaning.hi: जैसे मन राग-रहित होकर पड़ता है

meaning.en: so the steady-minded in his work
meaning.hi: वैसे ही धीर बुद्धि अपने कार्यों में

meaning.en: a pleasure enjoyed with full understanding
meaning.hi: पूरी तरह जानकर भोगा गया भोग

meaning.en: brings contentment
a thief dealt with knowingly
becomes a friend, not a thief
come upon without expecting it
as a village festival is watched by travellers
meaning.hi: जैसे राहगीर गाँव का उत्सव देखते हैं

meaning.en: just so by the wise
the splendour of pleasures is looked upon
meaning.hi: भोगों की शोभा देखी जाती है

meaning.en: of a mind held in check
even a small, light pleasure
that very one, not blown up big
meaning.hi: उसी को, जो बढ़ाया नहीं गया

meaning.en: it values highly, having known hardship
meaning.hi: कष्ट के कारण बहुत मानता है

meaning.en: a king freed from captivity
is happy with a single mouthful
meaning.hi: एक कौर से ही सन्तुष्ट होता है

meaning.en: one never bound or attacked by others
meaning.hi: जो दूसरों से न बँधा, न घिरा

meaning.en: does not think much even of a kingdom
meaning.hi: राज्य को भी बहुत नहीं मानता

meaning.en: pressing hand hard against hand
and grinding teeth against teeth
as if bracing limb against limb
meaning.hi: मानो अंगों से अंगों को वश में कर

meaning.en: first conquer your own mind
no way out except victory over the mind
meaning.hi: मन की विजय के सिवा अन्य गति नहीं

meaning.en: in the ocean of becoming
in the great empire of hell
misdeeds like elephants maddened in rut
armed with the arrows of hope
the senses are enemies hard to conquer
for one whose mind's arrogance is worn away
meaning.hi: जिसके चित्त का दर्प क्षीण है

meaning.en: who has subdued the hostile senses
meaning.hi: जिसने इन्द्रिय-शत्रुओं को वश में किया

meaning.en: cravings for pleasure wither like lotuses in winter
meaning.hi: भोग-वासनाएँ सर्दी में कमलिनियों-सी क्षीण होती हैं

meaning.en: till then, like ghouls in the night
meaning.hi: तब तक रात के बेतालों की तरह

meaning.en: cravings dwell in the heart
as long as the mind is not won by firm practice of the one truth
meaning.hi: जब तक एक तत्त्व के दृढ़ अभ्यास से मन न जीता जाए

meaning.en: a servant, for doing what is wanted
a minister, for bringing about every aim
meaning.hi: मन्त्री, सब अर्थ सिद्ध करने से

meaning.en: a vassal, for keeping the senses in check
meaning.hi: सामन्त, इन्द्रियों को वश में रखने से

meaning.en: so I regard the mind of the discerning
meaning.hi: विवेकी के मन को मैं ऐसा मानता हूँ

meaning.en: a loving wife, for her tender care
a father, for his protection
a friend, for his excellent counsel
so I regard the mind of the wise
meaning.hi: मनीषी के मन को मैं ऐसा मानता हूँ

meaning.en: through its own light and the eye of scripture
through its own understanding and experience
grants the highest fulfilment
the father-mind, giving up itself
meaning.hi: मन रूपी पिता, स्वयं को त्यागकर

meaning.en: well-pleased, very steady, clear
well-mastered and fully awakened
strengthened by its own good qualities
the lovely jewel of the mind shines in the heart
meaning.hi: हृदय में मनोहर मनोमणि चमकती है

meaning.en: this jewel of the mind, O learned one
smeared with much mud
with the water of discrimination, for fulfilment
wash it and become full of light
taking refuge in the highest discrimination
and seeing the truth with understanding
meaning.hi: और बुद्धि से सत्य को देखकर

meaning.en: cutting down the enemy senses completely
cross over the ocean of becoming
leaning on things alone, of endless
they know as the mine of sorrows
not leaning at all, on every side
they know as the home of joys
this world, tied by the thread of craving
meaning.hi: वासना के धागे से बँधा यह लोक

meaning.en: goes round and round
when strong, it brings great sorrow
meaning.hi: प्रबल होकर वह बड़े दुख के लिए है

meaning.en: when cut away, it leads to happiness
meaning.hi: कटकर वह सुख के लिए है

meaning.en: even the steady, even the deeply learned
even the nobly born, even the great
a being is bound by craving
as a lion by a chain
the highest human effort and diligence
taking it up with sustained energy
meaning.hi: उसे अपनाकर, अच्छे उद्यम के साथ

meaning.en: acting calmly in line with scripture
meaning.hi: शास्त्र के अनुसार बिना उद्वेग के आचरण करते हुए

meaning.en: who would fail to reach fulfilment?
meaning.hi: कौन सिद्धि का भागी न होगा?

meaning.en: I am all this universe
I am the Supreme Self, the imperishable
with the awareness that there is nothing else
meaning.hi: और कुछ नहीं है, इस संवित्ति से

meaning.en: that is the highest sense of 'I'
I am distinct from everything
I am finer even than a hair's tip
meaning.hi: मैं बाल की नोक से भी सूक्ष्म हूँ

meaning.en: this awareness, O learned one
meaning.hi: हे ब्रह्मन्, यह जो संवित् है

meaning.en: is the second, blessed sense of 'I'
this is for freedom
not for bondage
in one liberated while living
it exists
'I am just this - hands, feet and the rest'
this conviction
is the third sense of 'I'
worldly and truly petty
this wretched separate self itself
the root of the hard-to-cross tree of worldly life
struck down by it, a creature
runs lower and lower
this wicked sense of 'I'
given up for good through a change of outlook
meaning.hi: भावना से सदा के लिए त्यागी गई

meaning.en: a person keeping only the refined 'I'
becomes calm and reaches liberation
the first two senses of 'I'
accepting those that are not worldly
