the third sense of 'I' must be given up
the worldly one that brings sorrow
then, giving up even those two
meaning.hi: फिर उन दोनों को भी छोड़कर

meaning.en: free of every sense of 'I'
he stands thus, exalted
meaning.hi: वह इस प्रकार अति ऊँचा स्थित होता है

meaning.en: and rises to the Supreme itself
meaning.hi: परम पर ही आरूढ़ होता है

meaning.en: bondage is nothing but desire for pleasure
giving it up is called liberation
the rise of the mind is ruin
the ruin of the mind is the great rise
the knower's mind dissolves
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी का मन विलीन हो जाता है

meaning.en: the mind of one who does not know is a chain

words.sanskrit: na anandam na nirananda na chalam na achalam sthiram

meaning.en: neither joyful nor joyless, neither moving nor still, yet steady
meaning.hi: न आनन्द, न निरानन्द, न चल, न अचल, फिर भी स्थिर

words.sanskrit: na sat na asat na cha etesham madhyam jnani-mano viduh

meaning.en: neither being nor non-being nor between - so they know the knower's mind
meaning.hi: न सत्, न असत्, न मध्य - ऐसा ज्ञानी का मन जानते हैं

meaning.en: just as, being so fine, lit by consciousness
meaning.hi: जैसे सूक्ष्मता से, चित् से प्रकाशित

meaning.en: space goes unnoticed
so the partless nature of consciousness
though everywhere, goes unnoticed
free of every imagining
stripped of every label
this is consciousness, imperishable by nature
meaning.hi: यही अविनाशी स्वभाव वाली चित् है

meaning.en: given names such as 'one's own Self'
clearer than a hundredth part of space
meaning.hi: आकाश के सौवें भाग से भी निर्मल

meaning.en: in knowers, a form without parts
the whole spotless world of appearances
seeing it as the one Self
meaning.hi: एक आत्मा के रूप में देखने वाली

words.sanskrit: na astam eti na cha udeti

meaning.en: it neither sets nor rises
meaning.hi: न अस्त होती है, न उदित

meaning.en: it neither rises up nor stays put
meaning.hi: न उठती है, न ठहरती है

words.sanskrit: na cha yati na cha ayati

meaning.en: it neither goes nor comes
meaning.hi: न जाती है, न आती है

words.sanskrit: na cha na iha na cha iha chit

meaning.en: consciousness is neither not-here nor here
this is consciousness
spotless in form
free of all wavering
resting on nothing
first, through qualities such as calm and self-control
one should purify the student
afterwards, 'all this is Brahman'
and teach, 'you are pure'
to one ignorant or only half-awake
whoever says 'all is Brahman'
into the nets of great hell
he is cast by that teacher
meaning.hi: वह उसके द्वारा डाला जाता है

meaning.en: to one whose understanding has awakened
whose desire for pleasure has worn away, who expects nothing
meaning.hi: जिसकी भोगेच्छा क्षीण हुई, जो निराश है

meaning.en: 'there is no stain of ignorance'
the wise teacher should teach
as light, when there is a lamp
meaning.hi: दीपक होने पर प्रकाश की तरह

meaning.en: as day, when there is the sun
meaning.hi: सूर्य होने पर दिन की तरह

meaning.en: as fragrance, when there is a flower
meaning.hi: फूल होने पर सुगन्ध की तरह

meaning.en: so, when there is consciousness, there is a world
meaning.hi: वैसे ही चित् होने पर जगत् है

meaning.en: this merely appears
it is not a world in the highest truth
when the eye of knowledge is clear
when the dawn of awakening has spread wide
as space, lit by awareness, being so subtle
goes unnoticed
so undivided consciousness, though everywhere
meaning.hi: वैसे ही निरंश चिद्भाव, सर्वव्यापी होकर भी

meaning.en: escapes notice
knowledge is gained, O learned one
meaning.hi: हे ब्रह्मन्, विद्या प्राप्त होती है

meaning.en: which carries away every fault
a weapon is stopped by a weapon
meaning.hi: शस्त्र शस्त्र से शान्त होता है

meaning.en: dirt is washed away by dirt
meaning.hi: मैल मैल से धोया जाता है

meaning.en: poison is neutralised by poison
meaning.hi: विष विष से शान्त होता है

meaning.en: an enemy is slain by an enemy
meaning.hi: शत्रु शत्रु से मारा जाता है

meaning.en: such is this illusion of beings
meaning.hi: प्राणियों की यह माया ऐसी है

meaning.en: which brings joy by its own undoing
meaning.hi: जो अपने नाश से हर्ष देती है

meaning.en: its nature cannot be pinned down
the moment it is looked at, it vanishes
meaning.hi: देखी जाते ही नष्ट हो जाती है

meaning.en: in the highest truth it does not exist
hold this with a blazing conviction

words.sanskrit: sarvam brahma iti yasya antah bhavana

meaning.en: one in whom 'all is Brahman' lives within
meaning.hi: जिसके भीतर 'सब ब्रह्म है' की भावना है

meaning.en: that grants liberation
seeing things as separate is ignorance
give it up entirely
O sage, that is not reached this way
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, वह इससे प्राप्त नहीं होता

meaning.en: the state called imperishable
'where did this come from?'
twice-born one, do not spend your inquiry on it
meaning.hi: हे द्विज, तुम्हारा ऐसा विचार न हो

meaning.en: 'how shall I destroy it?'
let this be your inquiry
when it has set and faded away
meaning.hi: इसके अस्त और क्षीण होने पर

meaning.en: you will know that state
where it came from, what it is like
meaning.hi: यह कहाँ से, और कैसी है

meaning.en: how it will end - (set aside); unbroken
of this house of sickness
make effort at its healing
so that it will not, in the sorrows of birth
meaning.hi: ताकि यह जन्म के दुखों में

meaning.en: bind you ever again
within its own Self, by its own stirrings
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा में, अपने स्पन्दनों से

meaning.en: the ocean of consciousness shimmers clearly
meaning.hi: चेतना का सागर निर्मल रूप से स्फुरित होता है

meaning.en: that is one in nature, undivided
hold this firmly within
that, stirred just a little in form
the power of consciousness, in the ocean of consciousness
made of that alone, it glimmers, clear
meaning.hi: उसी से बनी, निर्मल होकर स्फुरित

meaning.en: right there, like a wave in the sea
meaning.hi: वहीं, सागर में लहर की तरह

meaning.en: in the Self, by the Self
as wind in the sky, or on a lake
meaning.hi: जैसे आकाश में, सरोवर पर हवा

meaning.en: just so, the Self by its own power alone
meaning.hi: वैसे ही आत्मा अपनी ही शक्ति से

meaning.en: grows restless within itself
meaning.hi: अपने ही भीतर चंचल होती है

meaning.en: for a moment that shining power flashes forth
meaning.hi: एक क्षण वह देवी कौंधती है

meaning.en: as the power to be everything
the force of place, time and action
has no power to drag her down
knowing her own nature thoroughly
still settled in the endless state
she pictures a form through a narrow measure
meaning.hi: वह सीमित माप से रूप की भावना करती है

meaning.en: not recognising herself
when a form has been pictured in this way
meaning.hi: जब इस प्रकार रूप भावित होता है

meaning.en: by that most lovely power
at once they follow after her
the ways of seeing: name, number and the rest
a shape drawn by mental distinctions
the home of place, time and action
this form of consciousness, O brahmin
meaning.hi: हे ब्राह्मण, चेतना का यह रूप

meaning.en: is called the knower of the field
imagining habits and cravings
it too then becomes the ego
meaning.hi: वह भी फिर अहंकार बनता है

meaning.en: the ego, judging and stained
is called the intellect
the intellect, shaped by its intentions
meaning.hi: संकल्पों का आकार ली हुई बुद्धि

meaning.en: turns into the thinking mind
meaning.hi: मनन के स्तर पर पहुँचती है

meaning.en: the mind, thick with alternatives
slowly becomes the senses
the body made of hands and feet
the wise know as the senses
in this way the living being
wound in the rope of intention and habit
its self caught in a net of sorrows
sinks step by step into lowness
meaning.hi: क्रम से नीचता को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: so awareness, made of power
hardened into a thick sense of 'I'
like the cocoon-spinning worm
meaning.hi: कोया बनाने वाले कीड़े की तरह

meaning.en: walks into bondage by its own wish
meaning.hi: अपनी इच्छा से बन्धन में जाता है

meaning.en: imagined by itself
living inside a net of subtle elements
meaning.hi: तन्मात्राओं के जाल के भीतर रहने वाला

meaning.en: falls into utter helplessness
meaning.hi: परम विवशता को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: like a lion bound in chains
meaning.hi: ज़ंजीरों में बँधे सिंह की तरह

meaning.en: sometimes mind, sometimes intellect
sometimes knowing, sometimes doing
sometimes this is the ego
sometimes remembered as chitta
sometimes it is called nature
sometimes pictured as illusion
sometimes named impurity
sometimes remembered as karma
meaning.hi: कहीं कर्म के रूप में स्मरण

meaning.en: sometimes known as bondage
meaning.hi: कहीं बन्धन के नाम से प्रसिद्ध

meaning.en: sometimes called the eight-part subtle body
sometimes declared to be not-knowing
sometimes agreed to be desire
this whole round of worldly life
which weaves the nooses of hope
carrying it, yet inwardly without fruit
meaning.hi: धारण करता, पर भीतर से फलहीन

meaning.en: as a banyan seed holds the banyan
scorched by the flames of worry
chewed by the python of anger
meaning.hi: क्रोध रूपी अजगर से चबाया गया

meaning.en: revelling in the waves of desire's sea
having forgotten its grandfather, the Self
lift the mind out, O brahmin
meaning.hi: हे ब्राह्मण, मन का उद्धार करो

meaning.en: like an elephant from the mud
thus the states that cling to the living being
meaning.hi: इसी प्रकार जीव पर आश्रित भाव

meaning.en: set in place by imagining worldly existence
their shapes pictured by Brahma
by the lakh and by the crore
countless, born in the past
and born even now on every side
meaning.hi: आज भी चारों ओर जन्मते हैं

meaning.en: and still others will arise
like clouds of spray from a waterfall
meaning.hi: जैसे झरने से बूँदों के झुण्ड

meaning.en: some in their first birth
some with more than a hundred births
meaning.hi: कुछ सौ से अधिक जन्मों वाले

meaning.en: some with countless births
some with two or three lives between
meaning.hi: कुछ दो-तीन जन्मों के अन्तर वाले

meaning.en: some heavenly musicians and singers
sky-wizards and great serpents
some are the sun, moon and Varuna
Shiva, Vishnu and the lotus-born Brahma
some brahmins and kings
stand as groups of merchants and labourers
meaning.hi: वैश्य और शूद्र समूहों के रूप में स्थित

meaning.en: some grasses, herbs and trees
fruits, roots and flying insects
some kadamba and citron trees
sal, palmyra and tamala trees
some the Mahendra, Malaya and Sahya ranges
Mandara and Meru
some the salt sea and the sea of milk
the seas of ghee, cane juice and water
meaning.hi: घृत, इक्षु और जल की राशियाँ

meaning.en: some are the wide directions
some are rivers of great speed
some high up in the sky
fall down and fly up again
like balls struck by a hand
meaning.hi: हाथ से मारी गेंदों की तरह

meaning.en: hit by Death without a pause
after tasting thousands of births
again into the tight pass of worldly life
meaning.hi: फिर से संसार के संकट में

meaning.en: some unawakened ones fall
even after gaining discernment
not marked off by direction, time and the rest
the truth of the Self, by its own power
when, simply in play, it takes on
meaning.hi: जब केवल लीला से धारण करता है

meaning.en: a body shaped by direction and time
that very Supreme
through the entry of the habit called 'living being'
meaning.hi: जीव नामक वासना के आवेश से

meaning.en: becomes the restless mind
leaning toward counting or not counting
the mind's power, as it starts to reckon
first pictures, in an instant
meaning.hi: पहले क्षण भर में भावना करती है

meaning.en: the clear idea of space
leaning toward the essence of sound
meaning.hi: शब्द-बीज के रस की ओर उन्मुख

meaning.en: then having grown dense
the mind, as its vibration thickens
meaning.hi: स्पन्दन के घने होने के क्रम से मन

meaning.en: pictures the stirring of wind
meaning.hi: वायु के स्पन्दन की भावना करता है

meaning.en: leaning toward the essence of touch
meaning.hi: स्पर्श-बीज के रस की ओर उन्मुख

meaning.en: from these two, space and wind
meaning.hi: उन दोनों, आकाश और वायु से

meaning.en: then through firm, repeated practice
meaning.hi: फिर दृढ़ अभ्यास के बल से

meaning.en: from those two, sound and touch
meaning.hi: शब्द और स्पर्श स्वरूप वाले दोनों से

meaning.en: from their friction fire is born
meaning.hi: संघर्ष से अग्नि जन्म लेती है

meaning.en: together with the subtle element of form
measured together with the three
meaning.hi: उन तीनों के साथ मापा हुआ

meaning.en: the mind, now carrying such qualities
senses the subtle element of taste
in an instant feels the coolness of water
meaning.hi: क्षण में जल की शीतलता जानता है

meaning.en: from that arises the awareness of water
meaning.hi: उससे जल का बोध होता है

meaning.en: then the mind, bearing such qualities
pictures in an instant
the subtle element of smell
from this arises the awareness of earth
meaning.hi: इससे पृथ्वी का बोध होता है

meaning.en: then, wrapped in the subtle elements thus formed
meaning.hi: फिर ऐसी बनी तन्मात्राओं से लिपटा

meaning.en: letting go of its fineness
a body like a spark of fire
sees it flickering in space
joined with a portion of ego
carrying the seed of intellect
that is called the eight-part subtle body
the bee in the heart-lotus of beings
within it, through a fierce urge
picturing a shining body
grows solid as it ripens
the mind, like a bilva fruit
meaning.hi: मन, बेल के फल की तरह

meaning.en: glowing like gold melted in a crucible
meaning.hi: कुठाली में पिघले सोने जैसी आभा

meaning.en: flashing in the spotless sky
then takes on an arrangement of parts
that radiance, by its own nature
above, a rounded mass that is the head
below, the part made of feet
at the sides, the hands in place
and in the middle, the belly
becoming distinct in time
becomes a flawless form
understanding, goodness, strength, eagerness
endowed with knowledge and mastery
he alone is the blessed Brahma
grandfather of all the worlds
Brahma, gazing at his body
lovely, his own, excellent
the blessed one fell into thought
whose clear sight spans the three times
in this highest space
whose one nature is pure consciousness
whose far shore and edge are unseen
meaning.hi: जिसका पार और छोर अदृष्ट है

meaning.en: 'what should come first?'
so Brahma pondered
his pure Self-vision freshly born
he saw hosts of creations
long past, many times over
then he remembers them all
meaning.hi: फिर वे सबको याद करते हैं

meaning.en: in the order of all their laws and qualities
meaning.hi: सब धर्मों और गुणों के क्रम से

meaning.en: in play he conjured up
wondrous creatures, by intention alone
busy with many customs and undertakings
like a mirage city of the gandharvas
for them, for heaven and final freedom
meaning.hi: उनके लिए, स्वर्ग और मोक्ष हेतु

meaning.en: for success in right living, desire and livelihood
meaning.hi: धर्म, काम, अर्थ की सिद्धि के लिए

meaning.en: countless and of every kind
he laid out scriptures
from the mind in the form of Brahma
since the world's existence is imagined
meaning.hi: संसार की स्थिति कल्पित होने से

meaning.en: this existence is said to last that long
meaning.hi: यह स्थिति उतनी ही कही गई

meaning.en: when that ends, it ends too
meaning.hi: उसके नाश से नष्ट होती है

meaning.en: is not born and does not die
anywhere, anything, ever
in the deepest truth, best of brahmins
all that is seen is false
meaning.hi: जो दिखता है सब मिथ्या है

meaning.en: the nest of the snakes of desire
give up the showy pageant of worldly life
knowing 'this is unreal'
settle into the stance of the knower
in the matter of a mirage city
whether decorated or plain
or in a son and such parts of ignorance
meaning.hi: या पुत्र आदि अविद्या के अंश में

meaning.en: what ground is there for joy or grief?
when wealth and family grow
meaning.hi: धन और परिवार के बढ़ने पर

meaning.en: there is sorrow, not contentment
when the web of delusion grows
who here finds real comfort?
by the very things that breed craving
for the fool, as they multiply
by those same enjoyments, for the wise
meaning.hi: उन्हीं भोगों से, ज्ञानी के लिए

meaning.en: letting go arises
so, Nidagha, knower of truth
in the dealings of worldly life
whatever is lost, let it go
meaning.hi: जो नष्ट हो उसकी उपेक्षा करो

meaning.en: whatever comes, accept it
of pleasures not yet come
a natural, unforced not-craving
and enjoying those that arrive
this is the mark of the wise
the pure state between 'is' and 'is not'
meaning.hi: सत्-असत् के बीच का शुद्ध पद

meaning.en: understanding it and holding on to it
the visible world, outer and inner
do not grab it, do not push it away
whether wanting arises or not-wanting
for the knower who stays at work
his wisdom is not stained
like a lotus leaf by water
if the glitter of sense-objects does not
stir in your heart, O twice-born
meaning.hi: हे द्विज, हृदय में स्पन्दित होती

meaning.en: then you have known what is to be known
meaning.hi: तब तुमने ज्ञेय को जान लिया

meaning.en: crossed over the ocean of becoming
for the highest state, with finest understanding
meaning.hi: ऊँचे पद के लिए परम प्रज्ञा से

meaning.en: from the mass of old tendencies
quickly, like drawing fragrance from a flower
meaning.hi: जल्दी, जैसे फूल से गन्ध निकालकर

meaning.en: set the mind's workings apart
in this ocean of worldly life
flooded with the waters of old tendencies
those who have boarded the boat of wisdom
they have crossed; they are the truly learned
meaning.hi: वे पार हुए, वे श्रेष्ठ पण्डित हैं

meaning.en: they neither abandon nor crave
meaning.hi: न छोड़ते हैं, न चाहते हैं

meaning.en: the ordinary business of the world
they go along with everything
meaning.hi: सब कुछ के अनुसार चलते हैं

meaning.en: people who know both shores
of the endless reality of the Self
whose nature is simply to be
consciousness turning toward the knowable
meaning.hi: चेतना का चेत्य की ओर उन्मुख होना

meaning.en: that is known as the sprout of intention
meaning.hi: उसे संकल्प का अंकुर जानते हैं

meaning.en: having gained existence little by little
that same sprout slowly grows thick
filling out as the thinking mind
hardening into dullness, like a cloud
meaning.hi: बादल की तरह दृढ़ जड़ता की ओर

meaning.en: consciousness pictures the knowable
meaning.hi: चेतना चैत्य की भावना करती है

meaning.en: as if it were separate from itself
seems to become intention
as a seed becomes a sprout
intention is simply the act of intending
it springs up by itself
and swiftly grows by itself
bringing sorrow, not happiness
meaning.hi: दुःख के लिए, सुख के लिए नहीं

meaning.en: do not keep imagining intentions
do not picture things while resting in yourself
meaning.hi: स्थिति में भाव की भावना मत करो

meaning.en: one set on ending intention
does not run after it again
simply by not picturing things
intention fades away on its own
meaning.hi: संकल्प अपने आप क्षीण होता है

meaning.en: intention by intention itself
the mind by the mind itself, O sage
meaning.hi: हे मुनि, मन से ही मन को

meaning.en: having cut them, rest in your own Self
meaning.hi: काटकर तुम अपनी आत्मा में टिको

meaning.en: what is so hard about that?
just as this sky is empty
so too the world is empty
as the husk of rice
as the tarnish on copper
is removed by working on it, O brahmin
meaning.hi: हे विप्र, क्रिया से नष्ट होती है

meaning.en: so too a person's impurity
of the living being, as of rice
impurity, though inborn and strong
meaning.hi: मल, सहज और प्रबल होते हुए भी

meaning.en: is surely destroyed, no doubt
meaning.hi: निश्चय नष्ट होता है, सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: so be one who makes the effort
letting go of inner reliance
on the glamour of things, built by imagination
meaning.hi: भावना से बनी भावों की शोभा पर

meaning.en: be just who you are
move through this world in play, O sinless one
meaning.hi: हे निष्पाप, इस जगत में लीला से विचरो

meaning.en: 'in everything, I am not the doer'
by this firmly held conviction
that which is called the supreme nectar
only evenness of mind remains
in pain, delight and pleasure
by the one sense that your own Self does all
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा के एकमात्र कर्तापन से

meaning.en: when your own intentions have dissolved
meaning.hi: अपने संकल्प के क्षीण होने पर

meaning.en: only evenness remains
evenness toward all things
the state that rests on truth
a mind settled in it
will never again be born
meaning.hi: फिर जन्म का भागी नहीं होगा

meaning.en: or else, the idea of doing everything
and the idea of doing nothing, O sage
giving up all, drinking the mind down

words.sanskrit: yah asi sah asi sthirah bhava

meaning.en: be steady as whatever you are
meaning.hi: जो हो वही, स्थिर हो जाओ

meaning.en: firm in what is left, fully collected
let go even of that with which you let go
meaning.hi: जिससे त्यागते हो, उसे भी त्यागो

meaning.en: the shapes of awareness, mind and reckoning
meaning.hi: चेतना, मन और कलना के आकार

meaning.en: light, darkness and the rest
old tendencies and the one who holds them
beginning with the stirring of the breath
giving up all of it, down to the root
like the sky, the mind wholly at peace
having thrown out completely from the heart
all the rows of stored tendencies
who stays with all restlessness gone
meaning.hi: जो व्यग्रता मिटाकर स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: he is free, he is the Supreme Lord
meaning.hi: वह मुक्त है, वह परमेश्वर है

meaning.en: all that was to be seen has been seen
meaning.hi: देखने योग्य सब देखा जा चुका

meaning.en: the ten directions wandered through in confusion
meaning.hi: भ्रम से दसों दिशाओं में भटकना

meaning.en: for the wise one who moves with clear reasoning
meaning.hi: युक्ति से चलने वाले ज्ञानी के लिए

meaning.en: the world-round becomes the size of a cow's hoofprint
meaning.hi: संसार गाय के खुर के निशान जितना

meaning.en: in the body, outside and inside
below, above and in every direction
meaning.hi: नीचे, ऊपर और सब दिशाओं में

meaning.en: the Self on this side, the Self on that side too
there is no world made of anything but the Self
meaning.hi: आत्मा से भिन्न बना कोई संसार नहीं

words.sanskrit: na tad asti na yatra aham

meaning.en: there is nothing where I am not
meaning.hi: ऐसा कुछ नहीं जहाँ मैं नहीं

meaning.en: nothing that is not made of That
meaning.hi: ऐसा कुछ नहीं जो उससे न बना हो

meaning.en: what else could I long for
all is spread out as being and awareness
meaning.hi: सब सत्-चित् रूप में फैला है

meaning.en: all this indeed is Brahman
meaning.hi: यह सब निश्चय ही ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: all this is the Self spread out
meaning.hi: यह सब फैली हुई आत्मा है

meaning.en: I am one thing and this is another
meaning.hi: मैं अलग हूँ और यह अलग है

meaning.en: give up this confusion, sinless one
in Brahman, spread out, solid, eternal
meaning.hi: फैले हुए, घन, नित्य ब्रह्म में

meaning.en: imagined things do not arise
there is no grief, no bewilderment

words.sanskrit: na jara asti na janma va

meaning.en: no old age, and no birth

words.sanskrit: yad asti iha tad eva asti

meaning.en: what is here, that alone is
be free of fever always
by experiencing whatever comes as it comes
meaning.hi: जो आए उसे वैसे ही अनुभव करने से

meaning.en: by not craving anything anywhere
meaning.hi: कहीं भी लालसा न करने से

meaning.en: one who has let go of both renouncing and grasping
meaning.hi: त्याग और ग्रहण दोनों को छोड़ने वाला

meaning.en: be free of fever always
for whom this birth is the last
into him very swiftly, great-minded one
pure kinds of knowledge enter
as pearls form in the finest bamboo
for those whose minds have truly turned away
meaning.hi: जिनका मन सचमुच विरक्त है उनके लिए

meaning.en: declared from my own experience
from the meeting of seer and seen
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा और दृश्य के मिलन से

meaning.en: the sure delight of experience
arising from the truth of one's own Self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा के तत्त्व से उठा

meaning.en: the motionless one we worship
meaning.hi: उस निश्चल की हम उपासना करते हैं

meaning.en: the seer, the seeing and the seen
letting them go along with stored tendencies
that which shines out as seeing and experience
meaning.hi: जो दर्शन और अनुभव रूप में चमकता है

meaning.en: the Self we worship
meaning.hi: आत्मा की हम उपासना करते हैं

meaning.en: always standing in the middle of the two
the two sides called "is" and "is not"
the light of all lights
the Self we worship
meaning.hi: आत्मा की हम उपासना करते हैं

meaning.en: passing over the Lord of the heart's cave
those who go after another god
meaning.hi: जो दूसरे देवता के पास जाते हैं

meaning.en: they go longing for a jewel
meaning.hi: वे रत्न की लालसा करते हैं

meaning.en: having thrown away the Kaustubha in their hand
these, whether risen up or not yet risen
meaning.hi: इन उठे और न उठे हुओं को

meaning.en: the enemies that are the senses, again and again
strike them with the staff of discernment
as Indra struck the mountains with the thunderbolt
meaning.hi: जैसे इन्द्र ने वज्र से पर्वतों को

meaning.en: in the bad dream of the night of worldly life
meaning.hi: संसार की रात के बुरे सपने में

meaning.en: in the empty delusion built around the body
meaning.hi: शरीर से बने खोखले भ्रम में

meaning.en: all of it is unclean
what is seen is the whirl of worldly existence
meaning.hi: जो देखा गया वह संसार का चक्कर है

meaning.en: beaten down by ignorance in childhood
struck down by infatuation in youth
in later life worn out by worry for wife and family
meaning.hi: बाकी जीवन में परिवार की चिन्ता से पीड़ित

meaning.en: what can such a fallen man do
meaning.hi: वह अधम मनुष्य क्या कर सकता है

meaning.en: on the head of what exists sits its not-existing
meaning.hi: जो है उसके सिर पर न होना

meaning.en: on the head of lovely things sits ugliness
on the head of pleasures sit pains
which one thing shall I lean on
meaning.hi: मैं किस एक का सहारा लूँ

meaning.en: those whose closing and opening of the eyes
is the dissolving and rising of the world
meaning.hi: संसार का प्रलय और उदय है

meaning.en: even such beings pass away
meaning.hi: ऐसे पुरुष भी चले जाते हैं

meaning.en: what count is there of those like me
worldly life itself, of sorrows
is called the home country
when the body has fallen into its midst
meaning.hi: जब शरीर उसके बीच गिरा हो

meaning.en: how could happiness be found
I am awake, I am awake
meaning.hi: मैं जाग गया, मैं जाग गया

meaning.en: this is the wicked thief of the Self
meaning.hi: यह आत्मा का दुष्ट चोर है

meaning.en: its name is mind; I shall put an end to it
meaning.hi: इसका नाम मन है, मैं इसे मारूँगा

meaning.en: I have long been robbed by the mind
meaning.hi: मन ने मुझे बहुत समय से लूटा है

meaning.en: do not fret over things to be rejected
meaning.hi: त्याज्य चीज़ों पर खेद मत करो

meaning.en: do not be wrapped up in things to be taken
meaning.hi: ग्राह्य चीज़ों में लीन मत हो

meaning.en: dropping both views, of rejecting and accepting
rest in what remains and be perfectly steady
meaning.hi: शेष में स्थित होकर स्थिर हो

meaning.en: freedom from anxious hoping, fearlessness
constancy, evenness, wisdom
freedom from craving and from restless doing
meaning.hi: लालसा और बेचैन कर्म से मुक्ति

meaning.en: gentleness, freedom from the mind's imaginings
steady resolve, friendliness
contentment of mind, softness, gentle speech
meaning.hi: मन का सन्तोष, कोमलता, मधुर वाणी

meaning.en: in the wise one freed from reject and accept
these dwell, free of old tendencies
cast by the huntress named Craving
meaning.hi: तृष्णा नाम की शिकारिन द्वारा फेंका

meaning.en: the wide-spread net of old tendencies
stretched over the waters of worldly life
woven through with threads of worry
with this sharp one, my dear
cut it with the needle of understanding
as a gale tears apart a mass of cloud
meaning.hi: जैसे आँधी बादलों के ढेर को

meaning.en: having cut it, stand in the vast state
meaning.hi: काटकर विस्तृत पद में स्थित हो

meaning.en: cutting the mind with the mind itself
meaning.hi: मन से ही मन को काटकर

meaning.en: as an axe cuts down a tree
reaching the state that purifies
be steady at once
standing, walking, sleeping, waking
staying, rising up, falling down
all this is utterly unreal
meaning.hi: यह सब पूरी तरह असत् है

meaning.en: being sure of this, give up leaning on it
if you cling to this visible world
meaning.hi: अगर तुम इस दृश्य का आश्रय लेते हो

meaning.en: then you are caught in the mind and bound
meaning.hi: तो तुम मन-सहित और बँधे हो

meaning.en: if you let go of this visible world
meaning.hi: अगर तुम इस दृश्य को छोड़ते हो

meaning.en: then you are free of the mind and liberated
meaning.hi: तब तुम मन-रहित और मुक्त हो

words.sanskrit: na aham na idam iti dhyayan

meaning.en: meditating "I am not, this is not"
meaning.hi: "न मैं, न यह" ऐसा ध्यान करते

meaning.en: stand unmoving like a mountain
within, between self and world
meaning.hi: भीतर, आत्मा और संसार के बीच

meaning.en: in the gap between seer and seen
meaning.hi: द्रष्टा और दृश्य के अन्तराल में

meaning.en: your own Self, whose name is seeing
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा, जिसका नाम दर्शन है

meaning.en: always contemplating it, become it
meaning.hi: सदा उसकी भावना करते हुए वही हो

meaning.en: free of the tasted and the taster
lying between the tasted and the taster
meaning.hi: स्वाद्य और स्वादक के बीच स्थित

meaning.en: meditating only on the tasting itself
meaning.hi: केवल स्वाद लेने का ध्यान करते

meaning.en: become filled with the Supreme Self
taking as support that which needs no support
stay steady in the very middle of the middle
meaning.hi: बीच के बीच में स्थिर रहो

meaning.en: those tied with rope are set free
meaning.hi: रस्सी से बँधे छूट जाते हैं

meaning.en: those tied by craving, by nothing at all
meaning.hi: तृष्णा से बँधे किसी से नहीं

meaning.en: therefore, Nidagha, craving, you
give up by dropping the mind's imagining
this unholy thing made of the sense of "I"
meaning.hi: अहंभाव से बनी इस अपवित्र को

meaning.en: cutting it with the needle of "not-I"
grown out of your own nature
be one in whom all fear of beings is stilled
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों का भय शान्त करके रहो

meaning.en: I belong to these things
and they are my very life
without them I am nothing
and without me they are surely nothing
meaning.hi: और मेरे बिना ये भी कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: giving up this inner conviction
examining it with the mind

words.sanskrit: na aham padarthasya na me padarthah

meaning.en: I am not the object's, and no object is mine
meaning.hi: न मैं पदार्थ का, न पदार्थ मेरा

meaning.en: when this has been deeply taken to heart
with an understanding that stays cool inside
meaning.hi: भीतर से शीतल बुद्धि के साथ

meaning.en: doing actions lightly, as in play
that surely is the letting-go of old tendencies
is called the meditative kind, O brahmin
meaning.hi: हे ब्राह्मण, वह ध्येय कहा गया है

meaning.en: seeing everything with an even mind
who has worn away the old tendencies
lets go of the body with no sense of "mine"
that is the knowledge kind of wearing-away
letting go of what is built on the sense of "I"
who drops old tendencies as easily as in play
remains, having given up even the object of meditation
meaning.hi: ध्येय को भी त्यागकर स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: he is called liberated while living
giving up the mind's reckoning, root and all
meaning.hi: मन के हिसाब को जड़ सहित छोड़कर

meaning.en: who through dropping old tendencies has reached calm
meaning.hi: जो वासना छोड़ शान्ति पा चुका

meaning.en: know this as the letting-go through knowledge
know him as free, the best of brahmins
meaning.hi: उसे मुक्त, ब्राह्मणों में श्रेष्ठ जानो

meaning.en: both of these have become one with Brahman
meaning.hi: ये दोनों ब्रह्मभाव को प्राप्त हुए

meaning.en: both are free of fever
unmoved by pleasures and pains that arrive in their time
meaning.hi: समय पर आए सुख-दुःख से अविचलित

meaning.en: the renouncer and the yogi, both self-mastered
there is no longer any wanted or unwanted
in whose inner outlook
who moves about as calm as in deep sleep
meaning.hi: जो गहरी नींद की तरह शान्त विचरता है

meaning.en: he is called liberated while living
joy, resentment, fear, anger
the moods of desire and self-pity
meaning.hi: कामना और दीनता की दृष्टियों से

meaning.en: who is neither elated nor downcast
meaning.hi: जो न हर्षित होता न मुरझाता

meaning.en: free of brooding over things
springing from old tendencies towards outside things
meaning.hi: बाहरी पदार्थों की वासना से उपजी

meaning.en: is called the craving that binds
free of every tendency towards any object
meaning.hi: सब पदार्थों की वासना से मुक्त

meaning.en: is called the craving that is free
the wish "let this be mine", through and through
the wish together with pleading
know it as a sharp chain
that brings sorrow, rebirth and fear
meaning.hi: जो दुःख, जन्म और भय देती है

meaning.en: that very wish, towards all things
meaning.hi: उसी इच्छा को, सब चीज़ों के प्रति

meaning.en: whether they exist or not, at all times
letting it go, one reaches the highest, most generous state
meaning.hi: छोड़कर परम उदार पद पाता है

meaning.en: the great-hearted one
leaning on bondage and leaning on liberation
meaning.hi: बन्धन में आस्था और मोक्ष में आस्था

meaning.en: the states of pleasure and pain too
giving up reliance on what is and what is not
stay like a great ocean that nothing stirs
a settled conviction arises
O good friend
of a person
of four kinds
from my feet to the top of my head, I
am produced by mother and father
this is one conviction, O brahmin
meaning.hi: हे ब्राह्मण, यह एक निश्चय है

meaning.en: leading to bondage
meaning.hi: बन्धन की ओर ले जाने वाला

meaning.en: beyond every object
I am finer even than the tip of a hair
meaning.hi: मैं बाल की नोक से भी सूक्ष्म हूँ

meaning.en: this second one is for liberation
meaning.hi: यह दूसरा मोक्ष के लिए है

meaning.en: the conviction arises in the good
the self of everything in the net of the world
I am all things, imperishable
and the third conviction is declared
for liberation indeed, best of the twice-born
meaning.hi: हे द्विजश्रेष्ठ, मोक्ष के लिए ही

meaning.en: I, or the whole world
empty, like open space, forever the same
meaning.hi: शून्य, आकाश की तरह, सदा सम

meaning.en: thus this fourth one too
is a conviction that brings liberation
meaning.hi: मोक्ष की सिद्धि देने वाला निश्चय है

meaning.en: of these, the first is said
to go with craving that leads to bondage
the three of purified longing are clear
meaning.hi: शुद्ध चाह वाले तीनों निर्मल हैं

meaning.en: liberated while living, moving with delight
meaning.hi: जीते जी मुक्त, आनन्द से विचरने वाले

words.sanskrit: sarvam cha api aham eva iti

meaning.en: "I myself am everything"
the conviction which, great-minded one
holding fast to it
the mind never again sinks into despair
meaning.hi: मन फिर विषाद में नहीं डूबता

meaning.en: it is called the void, nature, illusion
meaning.hi: उसे शून्य, प्रकृति, माया कहते हैं

meaning.en: and Brahman, and pure consciousness
Shiva, the Person, the Lord
and it is called the eternal Self
through forms that arise as the many and the one
meaning.hi: द्वैत और अद्वैत रूप में उपजे रूपों से

meaning.en: in the play of building the world
the power made of the Supreme Self
itself undivided, opens out and unfolds
resting on the state beyond everything
meaning.hi: सबसे परे की अवस्था पर टिका

meaning.en: complete, single, made of pure awareness
neither upset nor smugly self-pleased
he does not sink in worldly life
always doing the work that comes his way
meaning.hi: सदा सामने आया काम करने वाला

meaning.en: seeing enemy and friend alike
free of the wanted and the unwanted
he neither grieves nor longs
one who says what is welcome to all
when asked, answering with gracious words
meaning.hi: पूछे जाने पर मधुर वाणी वाला

meaning.en: and who knows what is in the hearts of beings
meaning.hi: और प्राणियों का आशय जानने वाला

meaning.en: he does not sink in worldly life
holding firmly to that earlier way of seeing
meaning.hi: पहली दृष्टि को दृढ़ता से थामकर

meaning.en: which happily lets go even of the object of meditation
meaning.hi: जो ध्येय-त्याग में आनन्द लेती है

meaning.en: at ease in yourself, as one free while living
go about in the world, free of fever
inwardly having dropped every hope
free of attachment, free of old tendencies
outwardly following every normal custom
meaning.hi: बाहर से सब आचरण निभाने वाला

meaning.en: go about in the world, free of fever
outwardly showing whatever eagerness is needed
with no eagerness in the heart
a doer outside, a non-doer within
go about in the world with a pure mind
meaning.hi: शुद्ध बुद्धि से लोक में विचरो

meaning.en: with the sense of "I" dropped and the mind reassured
beautiful and clear as the sky
taking on no stain or blemish
go about in the world with a pure mind
meaning.hi: शुद्ध बुद्धि से लोक में विचरो

meaning.en: generous and gracious in conduct
inwardly letting go of all clinging
outwardly as if busy with many things
holding dispassion within
"this one is my own, that one is not"
is the counting of small minds
meaning.hi: छोटे मन वालों की गिनती है

meaning.en: but for those of generous conduct
meaning.hi: पर उदार आचरण वालों के लिए

meaning.en: the whole earth is one family
free of both being and non-being
untouched by old age and death
where even the start of mental reckoning is stilled
meaning.hi: जहाँ मन के हिसाब का आरम्भ भी शान्त है

meaning.en: take shelter in the passionless state
this is the clear state of being established in Brahman
free of desire, free of every sickness
taking hold of it and living thus
one is not confused even in crises
through dispassion and through scripture
and through noble qualities such as greatness of heart
meaning.hi: और महत्ता आदि गुणों से भी

meaning.en: so as to carry away the restless imagining
one must lift up the mind by oneself
meaning.hi: स्वयं ही मन को ऊपर उठाए

meaning.en: through dispassion it grows full
the mind that runs after perishing things
meaning.hi: नश्वर चीज़ों के पीछे चलने वाला मन

meaning.en: through hope it becomes coloured with attachment
meaning.hi: आशा से रँगा और आसक्त होता है

meaning.en: like a spotless lake in autumn
meaning.hi: शरद की निर्मल झील की तरह

meaning.en: that same thing which gives no real taste of enjoyment
meaning.hi: वही जो भोग में नीरस है

meaning.en: the heap of busy activity, again and again
doing it day after day
why, wise one, is he not embarrassed
meaning.hi: हे बुद्धिमान, वह लज्जित क्यों नहीं होता

meaning.en: bondage is awareness tangled with what it knows
meaning.hi: बन्धन है चेतना का विषयों में उलझना

meaning.en: freedom from that is called liberation
awareness without objects is truly the Self
this is the summary of every teaching
meaning.hi: यह सब सिद्धान्तों का सार है

meaning.en: taking up this firm understanding
look with a mind set ablaze
by yourself, through the Self, the Self
meaning.hi: स्वयं ही, आत्मा से, आत्मा को

meaning.en: you will reach the state of pure joy
I am awareness, these worlds are awareness
meaning.hi: मैं चित् हूँ, ये लोक चित् हैं

meaning.en: the directions are awareness, these beings are awareness
meaning.hi: दिशाएँ चित् हैं, ये प्राणी चित् हैं

meaning.en: free of both the seen and the seeing
having only a pure, spotless form
forever shining, never setting
meaning.hi: सदा उदित, कभी अस्त न होने वाला

meaning.en: not one more appearance among appearances
the one who sees, the silent witness
whose very nature is awareness
awareness set free from every object of knowing
meaning.hi: ज्ञेय से मुक्त चेतना का रूप

meaning.en: fullness of light by nature
where all that could be known has fallen quiet
I am pure knowing alone, the Great
meaning.hi: मैं केवल शुद्ध ज्ञान हूँ, महान

meaning.en: with every restless intention stilled
with every craving brought to rest
going to the state beyond the mind's divisions
be at ease in your own Self, O lord of sages
meaning.hi: हे मुनीश्वर, स्वस्थ होकर आत्मा में स्थित रहो
